title: The polymerase milieu of human papillomavirus.
abstract: ABSTRACT High-risk human papillomaviruses (HPVs) cause cervical, anogenital, and head and neck cancers. A key oncogenic mechanism involves viral exploitation of host DNA damage tolerance pathways to support productive replication, a process that also drives genomic instability. Despite evidence that specific cellular polymerases participate in HPV genome replication, the full complement of polymerases deployed across the viral life cycle remains poorly defined. This minireview examines the potential roles of both replicative and translesion synthesis (TLS) polymerases at distinct stages of the HPV life cycle, and new tools that can be used to assess their potential importance in driving cancer, the life cycle, and altering mutagenic potential.

title_original: The polymerase milieu of human papillomavirus.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the roles of cellular polymerases, including replicative and translesion synthesis (TLS) polymerases, in the life cycle of high-risk human papillomaviruses (HPVs), particularly HPV16, HPV18, HPV31, HPV33, HPV45, HPV52, and HPV58, which are causally linked to cervical, anogenital, and head and neck cancers. The central question focuses on identifying the full complement of polymerases deployed during distinct stages of the HPV life cycle and their contributions to viral replication, genomic instability, and oncogenesis.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative minireview that synthesizes existing evidence on the involvement of cellular polymerases in HPV genome replication and oncogenesis. It does not report a systematic search, eligibility criteria, included-study count, or meta-analytic methods. The review highlights gaps in understanding the complete polymerase milieu utilized by HPV across its life cycle.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: There is consensus that high-risk HPVs exploit host DNA damage tolerance pathways, including specific cellular polymerases, to support productive replication, which contributes to genomic instability and oncogenesis. However, the full complement of polymerases involved in HPV genome replication remains poorly defined, and the specific roles of replicative versus TLS polymerases at distinct life cycle stages are not fully elucidated.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies a critical gap in knowledge regarding the complete set of polymerases deployed by HPV during its life cycle, particularly the relative contributions of replicative and TLS polymerases. The lack of definitive evidence on which polymerases are essential at each stage and their roles in driving mutagenic potential and cancer progression remains unresolved.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for new experimental tools and approaches to assess the importance of specific polymerases in HPV replication, life cycle progression, and oncogenic potential. Priorities include identifying polymerase targets for antiviral strategies, understanding polymerase-mediated mutagenic processes, and developing tools to dissect polymerase contributions to HPV-associated cancers.

analysis.summary_en: This minireview explores how high-risk human papillomaviruses (HPVs), including HPV16, HPV18, and others, exploit host cellular polymerases—both replicative and translesion synthesis (TLS) enzymes—to support their life cycle and drive oncogenesis. While it is established that HPV leverages host DNA damage tolerance pathways to enable productive replication and genomic instability, the full complement of polymerases involved remains undefined. The review highlights unresolved questions about the specific roles of different polymerases at distinct life cycle stages and their contributions to mutagenic potential and cancer development. It calls for the development of new tools to dissect these mechanisms and identify potential antiviral targets.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了细胞聚合酶(包括复制和跨病灶合成 (TLS) 聚合酶)在高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 生命周期中的作用,特别是 HPV16、HPV18、HPV31、HPV33、HPV45、HPV52 和 HPV58,这些病毒与宫颈癌、肛门生殖器癌和头颈癌存在因果关系。核心问题集中于确定 HPV 生命周期不同阶段部署的全部聚合酶及其对病毒复制、基因组不稳定性和肿瘤发生的贡献。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是一篇叙述性小型综述,综合了细胞聚合酶参与 HPV 基因组 复制和肿瘤发生的现有证据。它不报告系统检索、资格标准、纳入研究计数或荟萃分析方法。该综述强调了在了解 HPV 在其生命周期中使用的完整聚合酶环境方面的差距。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 人们一致认为,高危型HPV 利用 宿主 DNA 损伤耐受途径(包括特定的细胞聚合酶)来支持高效复制,从而导致基因组不稳定和肿瘤发生。然而,参与 HPV 基因组 复制的完整聚合酶仍不清楚,并且复制聚合酶与 TLS 聚合酶在不同生命周期阶段的具体作用尚未完全阐明。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查发现了有关 HPV 在其生命周期中使用的整套聚合酶的知识中的一个关键差距,特别是复制聚合酶和 TLS 聚合酶的相对贡献。缺乏明确的证据表明聚合酶在每个阶段都是必需的,以及它们在驱动突变潜力和癌症进展中的作用仍然悬而未决。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调需要新的实验工具和方法来评估特定聚合酶在 HPV 复制、生命周期进展和致癌潜力中的重要性。优先事项包括确定 抗病毒药物 策略的聚合酶靶标、了解聚合酶介导的诱变过程以及开发工具来剖析聚合酶对 HPV 相关癌症的影响。

abstract_zh: 摘要 高风险 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 会导致宫颈癌、肛门生殖器癌和头颈癌。一个关键的致癌机制涉及病毒利用 宿主 DNA 损伤耐受途径来支持高效复制,这一过程也会导致基因组不稳定。尽管有证据表明特定的细胞聚合酶参与 HPV 基因组 复制,但在病毒生命周期中部署的完整聚合酶仍不清楚。这篇小型综述探讨了复制聚合酶和跨损伤合成 (TLS) 聚合酶在 HPV 生命周期不同阶段的潜在作用,以及可用于评估它们在驱动癌症、生命周期和改变诱变潜力方面的潜在重要性的新工具。

title: Mothers' intentions for adolescent sons' human papillomavirus vaccination in Japan: Psychosocial factors and relative influences across intention groups.
abstract: ABSTRACT As human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination for men remains non-routine in Japan, this study aimed to explore psychosocial factors associated with mothers’ intentions to vaccinate their adolescent sons, and compared the strength of these correlates across intention groups. A web-based cross-sectional survey targeted mothers with boys aged 11–16 years in Japan. Participants were classified by intention into accepting (strongly/relatively agree), undecided (unknown), and refusing (strongly/relatively disagree) groups. Binary logistic regression compared the accepting versus undecided groups and accepting versus refusing groups. Among 301 mothers, 22.6% were accepting, 57.5% undecided, and 19.9% refusing. Normative beliefs exhibited the strongest association, with the highest odds ratio (OR), when comparing accepting versus undecided (OR = 12.63, 95% CI 6.03–26.47) and accepting versus refusing groups (OR = 26.72, 95% CI 9.69–73.74). This was followed by perceived importance of prevention, best-friend influence, anticipatory regret, and perceived susceptibility. Associations were generally stronger in comparisons between accepting and refusing groups than between accepting and undecided groups. The undecided group reported greater perceived logistical hassle. The refusing group was less likely to have completed children’s routine childhood vaccinations before entering elementary school or eldest son’s influenza vaccination and was less influenced by municipal notifications or doctors’ recommendations. Tailored interventions are needed, including those enhancing subjective norms, perceived prevention value, and risk communication for undecided and refusing mothers; providing logistical support for undecided mothers; and implementing multi‐channel, trust‐building communication strategies for refusing mothers. Japan should prioritize boys’ HPV vaccination through multifaceted strategies addressing these psychosocial barriers.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates psychosocial factors influencing mothers’ intentions to vaccinate their adolescent sons against HPV in Japan, where male HPV vaccination is not routine. Using a cross-sectional survey of mothers with boys aged 11–16 years, the research classified participants into accepting, undecided, and refusing intention groups and applied binary logistic regression to compare groups. Normative beliefs emerged as the strongest correlate of vaccination intention, with markedly higher odds ratios when comparing accepting versus refusing groups than accepting versus undecided groups. The undecided group reported greater perceived logistical hassle, while the refusing group showed lower uptake of routine childhood and influenza vaccinations. The findings highlight the need for targeted interventions, including strengthening subjective norms, improving perceived prevention value, addressing logistical barriers for undecided mothers, and employing multi-channel trust-building strategies for refusing mothers to enhance HPV vaccination uptake among boys in Japan.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究调查了日本母亲为青春期儿子接种 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗的意愿的心理社会决定因素,其中男性的 HPV 疫苗接种 并不常规,重点关注区分接受、犹豫和拒绝意图群体的因素。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 一项基于网络的横断面调查针对日本 11-16 岁男孩的母亲,将参与者分为接受、犹豫不决和拒绝意向组,并使用二元逻辑回归来比较接受组与未决定组、接受组与拒绝组。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 规范信念与 疫苗接种 意图的关联性最强,接受组与未决定组的比值比为 12.63 (95% CI 6.03–26.47),接受组与拒绝组的比值比为 26.72 (95% CI 9.69–73.74)。接受组和拒绝组之间的关联通常比接受组和未决定组之间的关联更强。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 犹豫不决的组报告了更大的感知后勤麻烦,而拒绝的组不太可能完成儿童的常规童年 疫苗接种 或长子的流感 疫苗接种,这表明 疫苗 的吸收存在潜在的行为和态度差距。

title: The IL-23/IL-17Axis in cutaneous verrucae: evidence from serum cytokine analysis in HPV infection.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cutaneous verrucae (warts) are benign epidermal proliferations caused by human papillomavirus (HPV) infection. The host immune response particularly T helper 17 (Th17) related cytokines such as interleukin-17A (IL-17A) and interleukin-23 (IL-23) plays a critical role in the regulation of viral control and inflammatory responses. However, the systemic levels of these cytokines in patients with verrucae have not been sufficiently characterized. OBJECTIVE: To investigate serum IL-17A and IL-23 levels in patients with cutaneous verrucae, to compare them with those of healthy controls, and to evaluate their associations with age, sex, number of lesions, disease duration, and lesion localization. METHODS: In this case-control study, 49 patients with palmoplantar or anogenital verrucae and 41 age- and sex-matched healthy controls were included. Serum IL-17A and IL-23 levels were measured using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Continuous variables were analyzed using the Mann-Whitney U test, and categorical variables using the chi-square test. Correlations between variables were assessed using Spearman correlation analysis. RESULTS: The median serum IL-23 level was 11.8 pg/mL (interquartile range, IQR: 7.8-21.3) in patients with cutaneous verrucae and 8.8 pg/mL (IQR: 7.2-12.0) in controls, with a statistically significant difference (p = 0.018). The median serum IL-17A level was 16.6 pg/mL (IQR: 8.7-37.9) in patients and 16.4 pg/mL (IQR: 10.9-24.5) in controls, with no significant difference between the groups (p = 0.755). A strong positive correlation was observed between IL-17A and IL-23 levels in patients (rs = 0.880, p < 0.001). No significant associations were found between cytokine levels and age, sex, number of lesions, disease duration, or localization. CONCLUSION: Elevated IL-23 levels and its strong positive correlation with IL-17A suggest that the IL-23/IL-17Axis may play a role in immune activation associated with HPV-related cutaneous verrucae. IL-23 may represent a potential indicator of immune activation associated with cutaneous verrucae; however, its standalone diagnostic utility appears limited. Future studies with larger cohorts and tissue-level analyses are needed to further elucidate the role of Th17-related cytokines in the pathogenesis of verrucae.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the systemic levels of IL-17A and IL-23 in patients with cutaneous verrucae caused by HPV infection and compares them to healthy controls. The research highlights the potential role of the IL-23/IL-17 axis in immune activation associated with HPV-related warts, as evidenced by elevated IL-23 levels and a strong positive correlation with IL-17A. The study is limited by its small sample size and absence of tissue-level analyses, which could provide more detailed insights into cytokine dynamics in HPV infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 皮肤疣(疣)是由 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染引起的良性表皮增生。宿主 免疫应答 特别是 T 辅助细胞 17 (Th17) 相关细胞因子,例如白细胞介素 17A (IL-17A) 和白细胞介素 23 (IL-23) 在病毒控制和炎症反应的调节中发挥着关键作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这项病例对照研究中,纳入了 49 名掌跖或肛门生殖器疣患者和 41 名年龄和性别匹配的健康对照者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用酶联免疫吸附测定(ELISA)测量血清IL-17A和IL-23水平。使用曼-惠特尼 U 检验分析连续变量,使用卡方检验分析分类变量。使用 Spearman 相关分析评估变量之间的相关性。
elements_zh.main_results: 皮肤疣患者的中位血清 IL-23 水平为 11.8 pg/mL(四分位距,IQR:7.8-21.3),对照组为 8.8 pg/mL(IQR:7.2-12.0),具有统计学显着性差异(p = 0.018)。患者中位血清 IL-17A 水平为 16.6 pg/mL(IQR:8.7-37.9),对照组为 16.4 pg/mL(IQR:10.9-24.5),组间无显着差异(p = 0.755)。在患者中观察到 IL-17A 和 IL-23 水平之间存在很强的正相关性(rs = 0.880,p < 0.001)。细胞因子水平与年龄、性别、病变数量、疾病持续时间或部位之间没有发现显着关联。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: IL-23 水平升高及其与 IL-17A 的强正相关表明 IL-23/IL-17Axis 可能在与 HPV 相关的皮肤疣相关的免疫激活中发挥作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: IL-23 可能代表与皮肤疣相关的免疫激活的潜在指标;然而,其独立诊断实用性似乎有限。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其样本量相对较小且缺乏组织水平分析而受到限制。

abstract_zh: 背景:皮肤疣(疣)是由 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染引起的良性表皮增生。宿主 免疫应答 特别是 T 辅助细胞 17 (Th17) 相关细胞因子,例如白细胞介素 17A (IL-17A) 和白细胞介素 23 (IL-23) 在病毒控制和炎症反应的调节中发挥着关键作用。然而,疣患者中这些细胞因子的全身水平尚未得到充分表征。目的:调查皮肤疣患者血清IL-17A和IL-23水平,与健康对照者进行比较,并评估其与年龄、性别、病变数量、病程和病变部位的关系。方法:在这项病例对照研究中,纳入了 49 名掌跖或肛门生殖器疣患者和 41 名年龄和性别匹配的健康对照者。使用酶联免疫吸附测定(ELISA)测量血清IL-17A和IL-23水平。使用曼-惠特尼 U 检验分析连续变量,使用卡方检验分析分类变量。使用 Spearman 相关分析评估变量之间的相关性。结果:皮肤疣患者血清 IL-23 中位水平为 11.8 pg/mL(四分位距,IQR:7.8-21.3),对照组为 8.8 pg/mL(IQR:7.2-12.0),差异有统计学意义(p = 0.018)。患者中位血清 IL-17A 水平为 16.6 pg/mL(IQR:8.7-37.9),对照组为 16.4 pg/mL(IQR:10.9-24.5),组间无显着差异(p = 0.755)。在患者中观察到 IL-17A 和 IL-23 水平之间存在很强的正相关性(rs = 0.880,p < 0.001)。细胞因子水平与年龄、性别、病变数量、疾病持续时间或部位之间没有发现显着关联。结论:IL-23水平升高及其与IL-17A的强正相关表明IL-23/IL-17轴可能在与HPV相关的皮肤疣相关的免疫激活中发挥作用。IL-23 可能代表与皮肤疣相关的免疫激活的潜在指标;然而,其独立诊断实用性似乎有限。未来需要进行更大的 队列研究 和组织水平分析的研究,以进一步阐明 Th17 相关细胞因子在疣状 队列研究 中的作用。

title: Evaluation of a Minigrant Program for Multilevel Interventions to Promote Human Papillomavirus Vaccination in Rural Communities in Georgia.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Rates of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine are lower in rural counties than in urban areas. The objective of the minigrants evaluation was to assess HPV vaccination uptake, factors related to implementation success, and barriers to implementation. METHODS: We conducted a concurrent, mixed-methods evaluation guided by the RE-AIM (Reach, Effectiveness, Adoption, Implementation, and Maintenance) and CFIR (Consolidated Framework for Implementation Science) frameworks. Four health departments received funding, a toolkit with implementation strategies, and monthly technical assistance calls or a learning collaborative for 1 year. The data sources were program documents, staff interviews and surveys, immunization databases, and caregiver or young adult surveys. Key evaluation metrics were 1) reach of patients and adoption of intervention levels (patient, provider, or practice); 2) HPV vaccination effectiveness; 3) implementation perspectives from staff, caregivers, and young adults; 4) implementation barriers and facilitators; and 5) program sustainability capacity. RESULTS: Most sites adopted 2 of 3 levels (patient, provider, or practice). Common multilevel strategies for series completion were patient education, incentives, provider training, and patient reminders. The total HPV vaccination rate increased 26.7% from 2023 to first quarter 2024, and initiation rate increase was 51.8% across the county departments. Overall, on a scale from 1 to 5, with 1 being "strongly disagree" to 5 being "strongly agree," sites reported positive experiences with program implementation and perceived the program was feasible (mean, 4.4 points), acceptable (mean, 4.4 points), and appropriate (mean, 4.2 points). Staff members also reported high ease of implementation (mean, 4.0 points) and commitment to program delivery (mean, 4.8 points). The parents or caregivers (n = 20) reported in surveys that they saw educational materials (100%), received educational materials (90%), and received a vaccine reminder (75%). CFIR-related facilitators were priority of the health issues, leadership involvement, technology infrastructure, communications about the vaccine and program, available resources, and staff training at the inner setting and external support at the outer setting. Barriers included limited resources, communication and structural characteristics (eg, technology, issues related to electronic health records), and local attitudes and conditions. The mean program sustainability capacity score was 4.2, with highest scores for evaluation, effectiveness, and workflow integration. CONCLUSION: Multilevel intervention strategies can successfully increase HPV vaccination rates in rural settings with implementation supports to address cancer prevalence in rural areas.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination in rural communities, focusing on multilevel interventions to increase uptake in Georgia. The central question addresses the effectiveness of minigrant-funded, multilevel strategies in improving HPV vaccination rates among rural populations.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review describes a concurrent, mixed-methods evaluation using RE-AIM and CFIR frameworks. Four health departments received funding, a toolkit, and technical assistance for 1 year. Data sources included program documents, staff interviews and surveys, immunization databases, and caregiver or young adult surveys.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Multilevel intervention strategies, including patient education, incentives, provider training, and patient reminders, increased HPV vaccination rates in rural settings. Total HPV vaccination rates rose by 26.7% from 2023 to early 2024, with initiation rates increasing by 51.8%. Sites reported high feasibility (mean 4.4), acceptability (mean 4.4), and appropriateness (mean 4.2) of the program.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Barriers to implementation included limited resources, communication challenges, structural issues (e.g., technology and electronic health records), and local attitudes. Sustainability capacity was moderate (mean 4.2), with highest scores for evaluation, effectiveness, and workflow integration, indicating potential long-term challenges.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Future efforts should prioritize addressing resource limitations and structural barriers to enhance program sustainability. Research should focus on optimizing multilevel strategies and evaluating their long-term impact on vaccination rates in rural populations.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates a minigrant program supporting multilevel interventions to promote HPV vaccination in rural Georgia. Using RE-AIM and CFIR frameworks, four health departments implemented strategies such as patient education, incentives, provider training, and reminders over one year. Results showed a 26.7% increase in total HPV vaccination rates and a 51.8% rise in initiation rates from 2023 to early 2024. Sites reported high feasibility, acceptability, and appropriateness of the program, with strong sustainability capacity in evaluation and workflow integration. However, barriers like limited resources, communication issues, and structural challenges persisted. The findings underscore the potential of multilevel interventions to boost HPV vaccination in rural settings while highlighting the need for sustained support and resource allocation.

title_zh: 对促进佐治亚州农村社区 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗接种 多层次干预小额赠款计划的评估。
source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Rates of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine are lower in rural counties than in urban areas. The objective of the minigrants evaluation was to assess HPV vaccination uptake, factors related to implementation success, and barriers to implementation. METHODS: We conducted a concurrent, mixed-methods evaluation guided by the RE-AIM (Reach, Effectiveness, Adoption, Implementation, and Maintenance) and CFIR (Consolidated Framework for Implementation Science) frameworks. Four health departments received funding, a toolkit with implementation strategies, and monthly technical assistance calls or a learning collaborative for 1 year. The data sources were program documents, staff interviews and surveys, immunization databases, and caregiver or young adult surveys. Key evaluation metrics were 1) reach of patients and adoption of intervention levels (patient, provider, or practice); 2) HPV vaccination effectiveness; 3) implementation perspectives from staff, caregivers, and young adults; 4) implementation barriers and facilitators; and 5) program sustainability capacity. RESULTS: Most sites adopted 2 of 3 levels (patient, provider, or practice). Common multilevel strategies for series completion were patient education, incentives, provider training, and patient reminders. The total HPV vaccination rate increased 26.7% from 2023 to first quarter 2024, and initiation rate increase was 51.8% across the county departments. Overall, on a scale from 1 to 5, with 1 being "strongly disagree" to 5 being "strongly agree," sites reported positive experiences with program implementation and perceived the program was feasible (mean, 4.4 points), acceptable (mean, 4.4 points), and appropriate (mean, 4.2 points). Staff members also reported high ease of implementation (mean, 4.0 points) and commitment to program delivery (mean, 4.8 points). The parents or caregivers (n = 20) reported in surveys that they saw educational materials (100%), received educational materials (90%), and received a vaccine reminder (75%). CFIR-related facilitators were priority of the health issues, leadership involvement, technology infrastructure, communications about the vaccine and program, available resources, and staff training at the inner setting and external support at the outer setting. Barriers included limited resources, communication and structural characteristics (eg, technology, issues related to electronic health records), and local attitudes and conditions. The mean program sustainability capacity score was 4.2, with highest scores for evaluation, effectiveness, and workflow integration. CONCLUSION: Multilevel intervention strategies can successfully increase HPV vaccination rates in rural settings with implementation supports to address cancer prevalence in rural areas.
abstract_zh: 简介:农村县的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗 发病率低于城市地区。小额赠款评估的目的是评估 HPV 疫苗接种 的吸收情况、与实施成功相关的因素以及实施的障碍。方法:我们在 RE-AIM(覆盖范围、有效性、采用、实施和维护)和 CFIR(实施科学综合框架)框架的指导下进行了并行、混合方法评估。四个卫生部门获得了资金、包含实施策略的工具包以及每月的技术援助电话或为期一年的学习合作。数据来源是计划文件、工作人员访谈和调查、免疫数据库以及护理人员或年轻人调查。主要评估指标包括 1) 患者的覆盖面和干预水平的采用(患者、提供者或实践);2) HPV 疫苗接种 有效性;3) 工作人员、护理人员和年轻人的实施观点;4)实施障碍和促进因素;5) 计划可持续性能力。结果:大多数站点采用 3 个级别中的 2 个级别(患者、提供者或诊所)。系列完成的常见多层次策略包括患者教育、激励、提供者培训和患者提醒。2023 年至 2024 年第一季度,HPV 疫苗接种 总发病率增加了 26.7%,各县部门的启动率增加了 51.8%。总体而言,按照从 1 到 5 的评分标准,1 表示“强烈不同意”,5 表示“强烈同意”,站点报告了计划实施的积极经验,并认为该计划是可行的(平均 4.4 分)、可接受的(平均 4.4 分)和适当的(平均 4.2 分)。工作人员还报告了实施的高度容易性(平均 4.0 分)和对计划交付的承诺(平均 4.8 分)。家长或看护人 (n = 20) 在调查中表示,他们看到了教育材料 (100%)、收到了教育材料 (90%) 并收到了 疫苗 提醒 (75%)。CFIR 相关的促进者优先关注健康问题、领导力参与、技术基础设施、有关 疫苗 和计划的沟通、可用资源以及内部环境的员工培训和外部环境的外部支持。障碍包括有限的资源、沟通和结构特征(例如技术、与电子健康记录相关的问题)以及当地的态度和条件。项目可持续性能力平均得分为 4.2,其中评估、有效性和工作流程集成得分最高。结论:多层次干预策略可以成功提高农村地区的 HPV 疫苗接种 率,并提供实施支持来解决农村地区的癌症 患病率 问题。

title: Identification of microRNAs as biomarkers for triage of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia in cervical scrape samples from high-risk HPV-positive women.
abstract: Abstract Background Cervical cancer (CC) is the fourth leading cause of cancer death in women worldwide. High-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) testing is highly sensitive but lacks specificity for identifying women at risk of progression. Reliable biomarkers are urgently needed to identify HR-HPV-positive women most likely to develop cervical cancer. Aberrant microRNA (miRNA) expression contributes to HPV-driven carcinogenesis and represents a promising diagnostic tool. Methods Cervical scrape samples from HR-HPV-positive women were histologically classified as low-grade (≤CIN1) or high-grade (CIN2/3). Total RNA was extracted and small RNA sequencing performed to identify differentially expressed miRNAs. Bioinformatic analyses included clustering, ROC curves, logistic regression, and functional enrichment. Selected candidates were validated byRT-qPCR in independent samples. Results Nineteen dysregulated miRNAs distinguished low- from high-grade lesions, six linked to viral and cancer pathways. Three (hsa-miR-501-3p, hsa-miR-1271-5p, hsa-miR-9-5p) were validated by RT-qPCR and showed strong discriminatory capacity. hsa-miR-501-3p reached high diagnostic accuracy (AUC = 0.88), which improved to 0.94 when combined with the others. The validated signature achieved high sensitivity and specificity for detecting high-grade lesions. Conclusion This pioneering study in Colombia using cervical scrapes demonstrates that miRNAs are potential biomarkers for high-grade cervical lesions and that this clinically relevant, minimally invasive sample routinely collected in screening supports their use.

source_records.abstract: BACKGROUND Cervical cancer (CC) is the fourth leading cause of cancer death in women worldwide. High-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) testing is highly sensitive but lacks specificity for identifying women at risk of progression. Reliable biomarkers are urgently needed to identify HR-HPV-positive women most likely to develop cervical cancer. Aberrant microRNA (miRNA) expression contributes to HPV-driven carcinogenesis and represents a promising diagnostic tool. METHODS Cervical scrape samples from HR-HPV-positive women were histologically classified as low-grade (≤CIN1) or high-grade (CIN2/3). title: Invasive Cervical Cancer Detection After Transition to Primary Human Papillomavirus Screening: Population-Based Linkage Study in Portugal.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Invasive cervical cancer (ICC) is a key outcome for evaluating cervical cancer screening (CCS) programs. Monitoring ICC trends and distinguishing cancers detected within and outside the organized screening program are essential for assessing program impact, particularly during transitions such as the introduction of human papillomavirus (HPV) based primary screening. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective population-based study in Portugal's Central Region (2014 - 2023). Deterministic linkage was performed between the organized CCS database and hospital morbidity records. Invasive cervical cancer cases were classified as screen-detected or non-screen-detected based on prior screening history. Incidence rates were calculated using population denominators. Poisson regression models with log link and log-transformed population offsets were fitted to estimate incidence rate ratios (IRR) comparing cytology-based (2014 - 2019) and HPV-based (2020 - 2023) periods, adjusting for temporal trends. RESULTS: A total of 654 ICC cases were included. Screening participation remained broadly stable over time. The HPV-based period was associated with a significantly higher rate of screen-detected ICC (IRR = 1.94; 95% CI 1.11 - 3.40) compared with the cytology period. In contrast, ICC incidence outside the organized screening program did not differ significantly between periods (IRR = 0.94; 95% CI 0.65 - 1.35). CONCLUSION: The transition to HPV-based primary screening was associated with a shift in ICC detection towards the organized screening program, without evidence of a corresponding increase in incidence among women diagnosed outside the organized screening program. These findings should, however, be interpreted with caution in light of the early phase of implementation and potential external factors influencing access to diagnosis. Overall, the results support a shift in detection within the screening pathway rather than changes in underlying disease occurrence. Strengthening integration between screening, hospital, and cancer registry data remains essential for robust evaluation of cervical cancer screening policies.

However, the early implementation phase and potential external diagnostic access factors warrant cautious interpretation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 侵入性 宫颈癌 (ICC) 是评估 宫颈癌 筛查计划的关键终点,区分在组织筛查内与外部检测到的癌症对于评估过渡期间的计划影响至关重要,例如采用基于 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 的初级筛查。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2014 年至 2023 年在葡萄牙中部地区进行了一项基于人群的回顾性研究,将有组织的 宫颈癌 筛查数据库记录与医院发病率数据联系起来,将 ICC 病例分类为筛查检测到或非筛查检测。
elements_zh.methods: 通过筛查和医院记录之间的确定性联系对 ICC 病例进行分类,并使用人口分母计算 发病率 率。具有对数链接和对数转换群体偏移的泊松回归模型估计了 发病率 比率 (IRR),比较基于细胞学 (2014-2019) 和基于 HPV (2020-2023) 的筛查期,并根据时间趋势进行调整。
elements_zh.main_results: 总共纳入了 654 例 ICC 病例,随着时间的推移,筛查参与度基本保持稳定。与细胞学检查期相比,基于 HPV 的筛查期与筛查检出 ICC 的比率显着较高相关(IRR = 1.94;95% CI 1.11–3.40),而有组织的筛查计划之外的 ICC 发病率 在不同时期之间没有显着差异(IRR = 0.94;95% CI 0.65–1.35)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证据,表明向基于 HPV 的初级筛查的过渡将 ICC 检测转向有组织的筛查计划,而没有增加在该计划之外诊断的女性中的 发病率,这支持筛查途径内的检测转变,而不是潜在疾病发生的变化。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,基于 HPV 的初级筛查可以改善有组织的项目中 ICC 的早期检测,凸显了整合筛查、医院和癌症登记数据以进行稳健的政策评估的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于基于 HPV 的筛查实施处于早期阶段,并且影响诊断的潜在外部因素,证据强度中等,这可能会限制普遍性和因果推断。

abstract_zh: 简介:侵入性 宫颈癌 (ICC) 是评估 宫颈癌 筛查 (CCS) 计划的关键结果。监测 ICC 趋势并区分有组织的筛查计划内外检测到的癌症对于评估计划影响至关重要,特别是在引入基于 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 的初级筛查等过渡期间。方法:我们在葡萄牙中部地区(2014 年至 2023 年)进行了一项基于人群的回顾性研究。在组织的 CCS 数据库和医院发病记录之间进行确定性链接。根据之前的筛查历史,侵袭性 宫颈癌 病例被分为筛查检测到或非筛查检测。发病率 率使用人口分母计算。拟合具有对数链接和对数转换群体偏移的泊松回归模型来估计 发病率 率比 (IRR),比较基于细胞学(2014 - 2019)和基于 HPV(2020 - 2023)的时期,并根据时间趋势进行调整。结果:共纳入 654 例 ICC 病例。随着时间的推移,筛查参与率基本保持稳定。与细胞学检查时期相比,HPV 检查检查期间的 ICC 筛查检出率显着较高(IRR = 1.94;95% CI 1.11 - 3.40)。相比之下,有组织的筛查计划之外的 ICC 发病率 在不同时期之间没有显着差异(IRR = 0.94;95% CI 0.65 - 1.35)。结论:向基于 HPV 的初级筛查的过渡与 ICC 检测向有组织筛查计划的转变相关,但没有证据表明在有组织筛查计划之外诊断的女性中 发病率 相应增加。然而,鉴于实施的早期阶段和影响 诊断 访问的潜在外部因素,应谨慎解释这些发现。总体而言,结果支持筛查途径中检测的转变,而不是潜在疾病发生的变化。加强筛查、医院和癌症登记数据之间的整合对于 宫颈癌 筛查政策的稳健评估仍然至关重要。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 侵入性 宫颈癌 (ICC) 是评估 宫颈癌 筛查计划的关键终点,区分在组织筛查内与外部检测到的癌症对于评估过渡期间的计划影响至关重要,例如采用基于 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 的初级筛查。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2014 年至 2023 年在葡萄牙中部地区进行了一项基于人群的回顾性研究,将有组织的 宫颈癌 筛查数据库记录与医院发病率数据联系起来,将 ICC 病例分类为筛查检测到或非筛查检测。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过筛查和医院记录之间的确定性联系对 ICC 病例进行分类,并使用人口分母计算 发病率 率。具有对数链接和对数转换群体偏移的泊松回归模型估计了 发病率 比率 (IRR),比较基于细胞学 (2014-2019) 和基于 HPV (2020-2023) 的筛查期,并根据时间趋势进行调整。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总共纳入了 654 例 ICC 病例,随着时间的推移,筛查参与度基本保持稳定。与细胞学检查期相比,基于 HPV 的筛查期与筛查检出 ICC 的比率显着较高相关(IRR = 1.94;95% CI 1.11–3.40),而有组织的筛查计划之外的 ICC 发病率 在不同时期之间没有显着差异(IRR = 0.94;95% CI 0.65–1.35)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证据,表明向基于 HPV 的初级筛查的过渡将 ICC 检测转向有组织的筛查计划,而没有增加在该计划之外诊断的女性中的 发病率,这支持筛查途径内的检测转变,而不是潜在疾病发生的变化。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,基于 HPV 的初级筛查可以改善有组织的项目中 ICC 的早期检测,凸显了整合筛查、医院和癌症登记数据以进行稳健的政策评估的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于基于 HPV 的筛查实施处于早期阶段,并且影响诊断的潜在外部因素,证据强度中等,这可能会限制普遍性和因果推断。

title: Role of Tonsillectomy in Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma With Unknown Primary in Human Papillomavirus-Negative Patients: A Prospective Observational Study.
abstract: ABSTRACT Introduction Management of cervical squamous cell carcinoma with unknown primary (SCCUP) continues to evolve with emphasis on tonsillectomy for identification of the primary. While the data from an HPV positive population is compelling, surgical ablation of potential primary sites in the oropharynx with the goal of identifying the primary in HPV negative tumors is debated. Methods In this prospective observational study, 21 patients with SCCUP underwent bilateral tonsillectomy in an attempt to identify a possible site of primary. Results Median age of this cohort was 59 years (39–74 years). Two of twenty patients were p16 positive. Only 1 patient (p16 positive) revealed a primary in the tonsil. Fifteen patients received adjuvant concurrent chemoradiation (CTRT), whereas two patients received adjuvant radiotherapy (RT). Median follow up was 17.6 months (0.26–60 months). The 2‐year overall and disease‐free survival rates were 81.5% (52.6%–93.7%) and 70.1% (42.1%–86.4%), respectively. No patient evinced mucosal recurrence. Conclusions Prevalence of human papilloma virus in patients with SCCUP is very low in India. Role of bilateral tonsillectomy to identify primary lesion in p16 negative patients is questionable.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the evolving management of cervical squamous cell carcinoma with unknown primary (SCCUP), particularly the debated role of bilateral tonsillectomy in identifying the primary site in HPV-negative patients.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This prospective observational study enrolled 21 patients with SCCUP who underwent bilateral tonsillectomy to identify a potential primary site, with a median age of 59 years (range 39–74 years).
analysis.methods: The study performed bilateral tonsillectomy in 21 patients with SCCUP to attempt identification of a primary lesion, with adjuvant treatments including concurrent chemoradiation in 15 patients and radiotherapy in 2 patients.
analysis.main_results: Only 1 of 20 patients (p16 positive) revealed a primary in the tonsil, while 2 patients were p16 positive. The 2-year overall and disease-free survival rates were 81.5% (52.6%–93.7%) and 70.1% (42.1%–86.4%), respectively.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors conclude that the prevalence of HPV in SCCUP is very low in India and that the role of bilateral tonsillectomy to identify primary lesions in p16-negative patients is questionable.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest limited utility of bilateral tonsillectomy for identifying primary sites in HPV-negative SCCUP, which may inform surgical decision-making and reduce unnecessary interventions in this population.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The small sample size (n=21), short median follow-up (17.6 months), and lack of mucosal recurrence data limit the strength of evidence, warranting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective observational study evaluated the role of bilateral tonsillectomy in identifying primary lesions among 21 patients with cervical squamous cell carcinoma of unknown primary (SCCUP). Only one p16-positive patient had a primary lesion identified in the tonsil, while two patients were p16 positive, indicating a low HPV prevalence in this cohort. The 2-year overall and disease-free survival rates were 81.5% and 70.1%, respectively. The authors conclude that bilateral tonsillectomy has questionable utility for identifying primary lesions in p16-negative SCCUP, particularly in settings with low HPV prevalence. However, the small sample size and short follow-up period limit the generalizability and strength of these findings.

title: Efficacy, immunogenicity, and safety of the 9-valent human papillomavirus vaccine in males aged 16-26 years in Japan: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Efficacy of the nine-valent human papillomavirus (9vHPV; HPV6, 11, 16, 18, 31, 33, 45, 52, and 58) vaccine was shown in females and inferred for males through immunobridging. We evaluated the efficacy of the 9vHPV vaccine in males aged 16-26 years. METHODS: This randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, efficacy, immunogenicity, and safety phase 3 trial was conducted at 22 clinical research, hospital, medical, or treatment sites in Japan, with masking of investigators, sponsor personnel, and participants. Healthy males aged 16-26 years with no history of human papillomavirus (HPV)-related lesions and no previous HPV vaccination were randomly assigned (1:1) centrally, using permutated blocks (block sizes of four), to receive three intramuscular injections of the 9vHPV vaccine or placebo (saline) at day 1, month 2, and month 6. The primary and secondary efficacy endpoints were the combined incidences of 6-month anogenital persistent infection related to HPV6, 11, 16, and 18 and HPV31, 33, 45, 52, and 58. Anogenital swabs and external genital tissue samples were tested for the presence of HPV DNA. Tissue samples were adjudicated for histopathology diagnosis. The primary and secondary efficacy evaluations were tested for superiority with a margin of 0% in the per-protocol population. Another secondary endpoint was antibody responses to each vaccine-targeted HPV type at month 7; immunogenicity analyses were conducted in the per-protocol immunogenicity population. Safety was assessed in participants who received at least one dose of vaccine or placebo. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT04635423) and is completed. FINDINGS: Between Nov 30, 2020, and Dec 25, 2021, 1059 participants were enrolled and randomly assigned to receive the 9vHPV vaccine (n=529) or placebo (n=530). Vaccine efficacy for the primary and secondary endpoints was 89·3% (95% CI 55·4-98·2; p=0·0002) and 63·5% (2·7-86·0; p=0·023), respectively, in the initial efficacy analysis based on a visit cutoff date of Dec 29, 2023, and 91·6% (67·7-98·6) and 72·9% (38·7-89·3) in the end-of-study efficacy analysis based on a visit cutoff date of July 16, 2024. Seroconversion rates were greater than 98% for each vaccine-targeted HPV type. Injection-site adverse events were reported in 370 (70%) of 529 9vHPV vaccine recipients and 162 (31%) of 530 placebo recipients, and vaccine-related systemic adverse events in 58 (11%) vaccine recipients and 52 (10%) placebo recipients; most cases were mild or moderate. No deaths, vaccine-related serious adverse events, or discontinuations due to adverse events were reported. INTERPRETATION: The 9vHPV vaccine prevents anogenital persistent infection related to vaccine-targeted HPV types in males and has an acceptable safety profile. These findings support the use of the 9vHPV vaccine in males to prevent HPV-related anogenital diseases. FUNDING: Merck Sharp & Dohme. TRANSLATIONS: For the Japanese translation of the abstract see Supplementary Material section.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 高危型 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 持续性肛门生殖器感染会给男性带来巨大的疾病负担,但 9 价 HPV (9vHPV) 疫苗 在该人群中的疗效数据有限。该研究解决了关于 9vHPV 疫苗 是否可以预防 16-26 岁男性持续感染的知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在日本 22 个临床中心进行了一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照 3 期试验。既往无 HPV 疫苗接种 或 HPV 相关病变的 16-26 岁健康男性以 1:1 的比例集中随机化,在第 1 天、第 2 个月和第 6 个月接受 3 次肌内注射 9vHPV 疫苗 或生理盐水安慰剂。
elements_zh.methods: 主要和次要疗效终点是与 HPV6、11、16、18 和 HPV31、33、45、52、58 相关的 6 个月肛门生殖器持续感染的组合 发病率。对肛门生殖器拭子和外生殖器组织样本进行 HPV DNA 检测,并对组织样本进行组织病理学判定。优效性测试在每个方案群体中使用 0% 的裕度。在第 7 个月时,在符合方案的免疫原性人群中评估了免疫原性,并在接受至少一剂的所有参与者中评估了安全性。
elements_zh.main_results: 2020年11月30日至2021年12月25日期间,共有1059名参与者入组(529名疫苗,530名安慰剂)。疫苗 的主要终点疗效在初始分析中为 89.3%(95% CI 55.4-98.2;p=0.0002),在研究结束时为 91.6%(67.7-98.6)。对于次要终点,最初的疗效为 63.5%(2.7-86.0;p=0.023),研究结束时的疗效为 72.9%(38.7-89.3)。每种 疫苗 靶向 HPV 类型的血清转化率均超过 98%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,9vHPV 疫苗 可预防男性中与 疫苗 靶向 HPV 类型相关的肛门生殖器持续感染,并表现出可接受的安全性。这是 9vHPV 疫苗 在 16-26 岁日本男性中的首次疗效试验,提供了针对多种致癌和非致癌 HPV 类型的保护作用的直接证据。

title_zh: 9 价 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗 在日本 16-26 岁男性中的功效、免疫原性和安全性:一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Efficacy of the nine-valent human papillomavirus (9vHPV; HPV6, 11, 16, 18, 31, 33, 45, 52, and 58) vaccine was shown in females and inferred for males through immunobridging. The primary and secondary efficacy endpoints were the combined incidences of 6-month anogenital persistent infection related to HPV6, 11, 16, and 18 and HPV31, 33, 45, 52, and 58. Anogenital swabs and external genital tissue samples were tested for the presence of HPV DNA. Tissue samples were adjudicated for histopathology diagnosis. The primary and secondary efficacy evaluations were tested for superiority with a margin of 0% in the per-protocol population. Another secondary endpoint was antibody responses to each vaccine-targeted HPV type at month 7; immunogenicity analyses were conducted in the per-protocol immunogenicity population. Safety was assessed in participants who received at least one dose of vaccine or placebo. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT04635423) and is completed. Seroconversion rates were greater than 98% for each vaccine-targeted HPV type. Injection-site adverse events were reported in 370 (70%) of 529 9vHPV vaccine recipients and 162 (31%) of 530 placebo recipients, and vaccine-related systemic adverse events in 58 (11%) vaccine recipients and 52 (10%) placebo recipients; most cases were mild or moderate. No deaths, vaccine-related serious adverse events, or discontinuations due to adverse events were reported. INTERPRETATION: The 9vHPV vaccine prevents anogenital persistent infection related to vaccine-targeted HPV types in males and has an acceptable safety profile. These findings support the use of the 9vHPV vaccine in males to prevent HPV-related anogenital diseases. FUNDING: Merck Sharp & Dohme. analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,9vHPV 疫苗 可预防男性中与 疫苗 靶向 HPV 类型相关的肛门生殖器持续感染,并表现出可接受的安全性。这是 9vHPV 疫苗 在 16-26 岁日本男性中的首次疗效试验,提供了针对多种致癌和非致癌 HPV 类型的保护作用的直接证据。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持在男性中使用 9vHPV 疫苗 来减少 HPV 相关的肛门生殖器疾病,为国家免疫政策提供信息,并将 疫苗接种 建议扩大到包括日本的青少年和年轻成年男性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其随访期短,并且排除了既往有 HPV 相关病变或 疫苗接种 的参与者,这可能会影响普遍性。由于单一国家环境和对替代终点而不是临床疾病结果的依赖,证据是中等的。

title: Transcriptional modulation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway mediated by HPV16 E5 , E6 , and E7 oncogene expression in breast cancer.
abstract: Aim Breast cancer is the most prevalent malignant tumor among women. Human papillomavirus (HPV) has been detected in breast tumors since the 1990s, and beyond its oncogenic potential, therapy resistance driven by viral immune evasion in non-anogenital tumors, such as oropharyngeal cancers, highlights the need to investigate viral activity in breast tissues. Among high-risk HPV types, HPV16 is one of the most prevalent and exhibits the highest carcinogenic potential. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate the expression of HPV16 oncogenes E5 , E6 , and E7 in breast tumors, as well as the modulation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway associated with viral activity. Methods A total of 92 breast cancer patients were included after Ethics Committee approval. Clinical data were obtained from medical records. RNA was extracted from formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissues and reverse-transcribed into cDNA. Transcripts of HPV oncogenes ( E5 , E6 , and E7 ), components of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway, and regulatory genes ( EGFR and PTEN ) were quantified by RT-qPCR. Gene expression levels were calculated using the ΔCt method. Results Forty-eight samples met RNA quality criteria and were included in the expression analysis. Among these, 77.08% showed expression of at least one viral oncogene, with E5 being the most frequently expressed. The PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway was modulated in HPV-positive samples, with increased PI3K expression and decreased mTOR expression. Notably, the high expression of E5-associated with immune evasion-combined with reduced mTOR expression suggests that HPV16 status may influence therapeutic response in breast cancer patients. Conclusions These findings reinforce the importance of further studies investigating HPV activity in breast tumors to better understand its biological and clinical impact.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乳腺癌是女性中最常见的恶性肿瘤,而高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HPV),特别是HPV16,自1990年代以来已在乳腺肿瘤中被检测到。除其致癌潜能外,病毒介导的免疫逃避在非肛门生殖器肿瘤(如口咽癌)中凸显了探究HPV在乳腺组织中活性的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 经伦理委员会批准后,共纳入92例乳腺癌患者,并从病历中获取临床数据。从福尔马林固定、石蜡包埋的组织中提取 RNA 并反转录成 cDNA 以供下游分析。
elements_zh.methods: 通过 RT-qPCR 对 HPV 癌基因(E5、E6 和 E7)、PI3K/AKT/mTOR 通路成分以及调节基因(EGFR 和 PTEN)的转录本进行定量。使用ΔCt方法计算基因表达水平。
elements_zh.main_results: 48 个样本符合 RNA 质量标准并被纳入表达分析。其中,77.08%表现出至少一种病毒癌基因的表达,其中E5表达最频繁。HPV 阳性样本中 PI3K/AKT/mTOR 通路受到调节,PI3K 表达增加,mTOR 表达减少。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: E5 的高表达与免疫逃避相关,再加上 mTOR 表达的减少,表明 HPV16 状态可能会影响乳腺癌患者的治疗反应。这些发现强调了进一步研究乳腺肿瘤中 HPV 活性的重要性,以更好地了解其生物学和临床影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究强调了 HPV16 癌基因表达在调节乳腺癌 PI3K/AKT/mTOR 通路中的潜在作用,这可能为未来有关 HPV 相关肿瘤的治疗抵抗和免疫逃避机制的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量的限制,并且依赖于从福尔马林固定、石蜡包埋的组织中提取的 RNA,这可能会影响 RNA 的质量和定量准确性。由于观察设计和缺乏对观察到的通路调节的功能验证,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 乳腺癌是女性中最常见的恶性肿瘤,而高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HPV),特别是HPV16,自1990年代以来已在乳腺肿瘤中被检测到。除其致癌潜能外,病毒介导的免疫逃避在非肛门生殖器肿瘤(如口咽癌)中凸显了探究HPV在乳腺组织中活性的必要性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 经伦理委员会批准后,共纳入92例乳腺癌患者,并从病历中获取临床数据。从福尔马林固定、石蜡包埋的组织中提取 RNA 并反转录成 cDNA 以供下游分析。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过 RT-qPCR 对 HPV 癌基因(E5、E6 和 E7)、PI3K/AKT/mTOR 通路成分以及调节基因(EGFR 和 PTEN)的转录本进行定量。使用ΔCt方法计算基因表达水平。
analysis_zh.main_results: 48 个样本符合 RNA 质量标准并被纳入表达分析。其中,77.08%表现出至少一种病毒癌基因的表达,其中E5表达最频繁。HPV 阳性样本中 PI3K/AKT/mTOR 通路受到调节,PI3K 表达增加,mTOR 表达减少。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: E5 的高表达与免疫逃避相关,再加上 mTOR 表达的减少,表明 HPV16 状态可能会影响乳腺癌患者的治疗反应。这些发现强调了进一步研究乳腺肿瘤中 HPV 活性的重要性,以更好地了解其生物学和临床影响。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究强调了 HPV16 癌基因表达在调节乳腺癌 PI3K/AKT/mTOR 通路中的潜在作用,这可能为未来有关 HPV 相关肿瘤的治疗抵抗和免疫逃避机制的研究提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量的限制,并且依赖于从福尔马林固定、石蜡包埋的组织中提取的 RNA,这可能会影响 RNA 的质量和定量准确性。由于观察设计和缺乏对观察到的通路调节的功能验证,证据强度中等。

title: Silicon dioxide vaginal gel and short-term high-risk human papillomavirus DNA detectability: A randomized controlled trial.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Intravaginal products, including silicon dioxide-based gels, are marketed to support short-term high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) clearance or loss of detectability, but independent randomized evidence testing these short-term claims against observation is limited. We evaluated whether daily intravaginal silicon dioxide-based gel treatment increases the proportion of women with no detectable cervical hrHPV DNA compared with observation alone. MATERIAL AND METHODS: This prospective, single-center, parallel-group, randomized, open-label controlled trial included women with PCR-confirmed cervical hrHPV infection and no indication for immediate treatment. Participants were randomized 1:1 to 3 months of self-administered daily intravaginal gel treatment or observation alone. The primary outcome was absence of detectable cervical hrHPV DNA by PCR at 3 months. Secondary outcomes during the randomized study period were patient-reported satisfaction and adverse events. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT05509413, https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05509413. RESULTS: Between November 2022 and January 2025, 242 women were randomized, with 121 allocated to each group. Primary-endpoint data were available for 208 women. At 3 months, hrHPV DNA was not detected in 18/99 women (18%) in the gel treatment group and 23/109 women (21%) in the observation group (absolute risk difference -2.9 percentage points, 95% CI -14 to 8; p = 0.60). A reduced post hoc adjusted sensitivity analysis did not materially change the interpretation of the primary comparison. Patient-reported adverse events were more frequent in the gel treatment group than in the observation group (32/99 [32%] vs. 2/106 [2%]; absolute risk difference 30 percentage points, 95% CI 21 to 40; p < 0.001). Satisfaction scores were high in both groups but lower with gel treatment. CONCLUSIONS: In this randomized trial, 3 months of daily intravaginal silicon dioxide-based gel treatment did not improve short-term loss of detectable cervical hrHPV DNA compared with observation alone. The trial did not reproduce the large short-term virologic benefit suggested by prior product-related studies. The findings do not support routine use of this intervention solely to promote short-term hrHPV non-detectability in women without an indication for immediate treatment, particularly given the higher frequency of local adverse events.

title_zh: 二氧化硅阴道凝胶和短期高风险 人乳头瘤病毒 DNA 可检测性:一项随机对照试验。
source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Intravaginal products, including silicon dioxide-based gels, are marketed to support short-term high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) clearance or loss of detectability, but independent randomized evidence testing these short-term claims against observation is limited. We evaluated whether daily intravaginal silicon dioxide-based gel treatment increases the proportion of women with no detectable cervical hrHPV DNA compared with observation alone. MATERIAL AND METHODS: This prospective, single-center, parallel-group, randomized, open-label controlled trial included women with PCR-confirmed cervical hrHPV infection and no indication for immediate treatment. Participants were randomized 1:1 to 3 months of self-administered daily intravaginal gel treatment or observation alone. The primary outcome was absence of detectable cervical hrHPV DNA by PCR at 3 months. Secondary outcomes during the randomized study period were patient-reported satisfaction and adverse events. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT05509413, https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05509413. RESULTS: Between November 2022 and January 2025, 242 women were randomized, with 121 allocated to each group. Primary-endpoint data were available for 208 women. At 3 months, hrHPV DNA was not detected in 18/99 women (18%) in the gel treatment group and 23/109 women (21%) in the observation group (absolute risk difference -2.9 percentage points, 95% CI -14 to 8; p = 0.60). A reduced post hoc adjusted sensitivity analysis did not materially change the interpretation of the primary comparison. Patient-reported adverse events were more frequent in the gel treatment group than in the observation group (32/99 [32%] vs. 2/106 [2%]; absolute risk difference 30 percentage points, 95% CI 21 to 40; p < 0.001). Satisfaction scores were high in both groups but lower with gel treatment. CONCLUSIONS: In this randomized trial, 3 months of daily intravaginal silicon dioxide-based gel treatment did not improve short-term loss of detectable cervical hrHPV DNA compared with observation alone. The trial did not reproduce the large short-term virologic benefit suggested by prior product-related studies. The findings do not support routine use of this intervention solely to promote short-term hrHPV non-detectability in women without an indication for immediate treatment, particularly given the higher frequency of local adverse events.

title: Magnitude of human papillomavirus vaccination uptake and its determinants among adolescent girls in Lesotho: a cross-sectional study.
abstract: Abstract Background To eliminate cervical cancer as a public health problem, the WHO recommends that human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines should be included in national immunisation programmes and should reach 90% of all girls by age 15 as primary prevention. Lesotho reintroduced the national HPV vaccine programme in 2022. Objective To investigate the prevalence and associated factors of HPV vaccination uptake among adolescent girls in Lesotho. Design A population-based cross-sectional study design. Participants Girls aged 15–17. Primary and secondary outcome measures A multilevel Poisson regression model with robust variance was applied to identify factors associated with HPV vaccination uptake. An adjusted prevalence ratio with a 95% CI was reported. Results The uptake of HPV vaccination among adolescent girls in Lesotho was 52.15% (95% CI 48.43 to 55.84). Girls aged 16 and 17 and those residing in the Maseru district were significantly associated with a lower proportion of HPV vaccination uptake. While, ever heard of cervical cancer and ever heard of sexually transmitted infections (STIs) were found to be linked with a higher proportion of HPV vaccination uptake. Conclusion HPV vaccination uptake among adolescent girls in Lesotho was far behind the WHO 2030 target. Raising awareness about cervical cancer and HPV vaccination via targeted education is vital. A comprehensive sexual health education programme that includes information on STIs and HPV can improve vaccination uptake, especially in districts with low uptake.

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为有针对性的教育策略提供了信息,以提高 HPV 疫苗接种 率,特别是在感染率较低的地区,并强调了预防 宫颈癌 宣传活动的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计的限制,无法确定因果关系,而且由于自我报告数据存在潜在偏差,证据不充分。

title: Integrated service delivery to improve adolescent health and human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination in Lao PDR: a quasi-experimental mixed-methods study - study protocol.
abstract: Abstract Introduction The Lao People’s Democratic Republic (PDR) faces the significant public health challenges of high cervical cancer incidence and suboptimal human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine coverage alongside broader adolescent health concerns such as high adolescent pregnancy rates and inadequate sexual and reproductive health (SRH) literacy. This study protocol outlines an approach to address these interconnected issues comprehensively by evaluating an integrated service delivery model. Methods and analysis This study employed a quasi-experimental design with mixed methods to assess the impact of an integrated service package comprising HPV vaccination and improved adolescent health services in two districts of Louangnamtha province in Lao PDR. The study population included girls aged 10–13 years for HPV vaccination and boys and girls aged 10–13 years for other adolescent health services. The intervention district received this integrated service package delivered through school-based, facility-based and outreach approaches. The comparison district continued with its standard HPV vaccination and routine adolescent health service delivery, which does not include the additional refresher training, comprehensive sexuality education or dedicated SRH outreach services provided in the intervention district. The intervention period was 7 months, from November 2024 to May 2025. Quantitative data on HPV vaccine uptake, SRH knowledge and attitudes and utilisation of adolescent health services were collected at baseline, midline (at 3 months) and endline (at 7 months). Qualitative data on barriers and facilitators to implementation, provider workload and capacity, and stakeholder perceptions were collected through in-depth interviews and focus group discussions with adolescents, caregivers, healthcare providers, educators, community leaders and policymakers at endline. Ethics and dissemination Ethical approval for the study has been received from the University of Health Sciences Research Ethics Committee in Laos (ID: 833/REC, dated 4 September 2024). Informed consent was obtained from all participants or their legal guardians. Findings will be disseminated through academic publications, policy briefs, workshops and community engagement activities to inform policies and practices in Lao PDR and contribute to the global knowledge base on integrated service delivery models. Trial registration number NCT06650956.

title_zh: 老挝人民民主共和国提供综合服务以改善青少年健康和 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗接种:一项准实验混合方法研究 - 研究方案。
source_body_en: Abstract Introduction The Lao People’s Democratic Republic (PDR) faces the significant public health challenges of high cervical cancer incidence and suboptimal human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine coverage alongside broader adolescent health concerns such as high adolescent pregnancy rates and inadequate sexual and reproductive health (SRH) literacy. This study protocol outlines an approach to address these interconnected issues comprehensively by evaluating an integrated service delivery model. Methods and analysis This study employed a quasi-experimental design with mixed methods to assess the impact of an integrated service package comprising HPV vaccination and improved adolescent health services in two districts of Louangnamtha province in Lao PDR. The study population included girls aged 10–13 years for HPV vaccination and boys and girls aged 10–13 years for other adolescent health services. The intervention district received this integrated service package delivered through school-based, facility-based and outreach approaches. The comparison district continued with its standard HPV vaccination and routine adolescent health service delivery, which does not include the additional refresher training, comprehensive sexuality education or dedicated SRH outreach services provided in the intervention district. The intervention period was 7 months, from November 2024 to May 2025. Quantitative data on HPV vaccine uptake, SRH knowledge and attitudes and utilisation of adolescent health services were collected at baseline, midline (at 3 months) and endline (at 7 months). Qualitative data on barriers and facilitators to implementation, provider workload and capacity, and stakeholder perceptions were collected through in-depth interviews and focus group discussions with adolescents, caregivers, healthcare providers, educators, community leaders and policymakers at endline. Ethics and dissemination Ethical approval for the study has been received from the University of Health Sciences Research Ethics Committee in Laos (ID: 833/REC, dated 4 September 2024). Informed consent was obtained from all participants or their legal guardians. Findings will be disseminated through academic publications, policy briefs, workshops and community engagement activities to inform policies and practices in Lao PDR and contribute to the global knowledge base on integrated service delivery models. Trial registration number NCT06650956.

title: Determinants of Parents’ Knowledge and Perceptions Regarding Human Papillomavirus Vaccination for Cervical Cancer Prevention
abstract: Abstract Introduction: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination is a highly effective strategy for preventing cervical cancer and other HPV-related diseases. Parental knowledge and perceptions play a critical role in vaccine acceptance. This study aimed to assess parents’ knowledge and perceptions regarding HPV vaccination and identify factors associated with poor knowledge among parents of girls aged 12–18 years in Tunisia. Methods: A quantitative, descriptive, cross-sectional, and analytical study was conducted among parents of girls aged 12–18 years in Sfax, Tunisia. Data were collected using an anonymous self-administered questionnaire assessing sociodemographic characteristics, knowledge of HPV infection and vaccination, and perceptions toward HPV vaccination. Factors associated with poor knowledge were analyzed. Results: Among 350 participants, the median age was 35 years, and 302 (86.3%) were mothers. Although 238 (68.0%) parents had heard of HPV and 262 (74.9%) had heard of HPV vaccination, knowledge remained limited, with a median score of 2 (IQR: 1–3); 139 (39.7%) participants had poor knowledge. Only 16 (4.6%) reported that their child had received HPV vaccination, whereas 167 (47.7%) refused it. The main barriers were concerns about vaccine side effects (46.0%) and insufficient information (31.1%). Lower education, low socioeconomic status, rural residence, unemployment, lack of previous HPV awareness, and absence of social media use were associated with poor knowledge . Conclusion: Despite relatively high HPV awareness, parental knowledge and vaccine uptake remain insufficient in Tunisia. Targeted education by healthcare professionals, school-based awareness programs, and evidence-based communication strategies are needed to improve HPV vaccine acceptance.

title_zh: 家长对 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗接种 预防 宫颈癌 的知识和看法的决定因素
source_body_en: Abstract Introduction: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination is a highly effective strategy for preventing cervical cancer and other HPV-related diseases. Parental knowledge and perceptions play a critical role in vaccine acceptance. This study aimed to assess parents’ knowledge and perceptions regarding HPV vaccination and identify factors associated with poor knowledge among parents of girls aged 12–18 years in Tunisia. Methods: A quantitative, descriptive, cross-sectional, and analytical study was conducted among parents of girls aged 12–18 years in Sfax, Tunisia. Data were collected using an anonymous self-administered questionnaire assessing sociodemographic characteristics, knowledge of HPV infection and vaccination, and perceptions toward HPV vaccination. Factors associated with poor knowledge were analyzed. Results: Among 350 participants, the median age was 35 years, and 302 (86.3%) were mothers. Although 238 (68.0%) parents had heard of HPV and 262 (74.9%) had heard of HPV vaccination, knowledge remained limited, with a median score of 2 (IQR: 1–3); 139 (39.7%) participants had poor knowledge. Only 16 (4.6%) reported that their child had received HPV vaccination, whereas 167 (47.7%) refused it. The main barriers were concerns about vaccine side effects (46.0%) and insufficient information (31.1%). Lower education, low socioeconomic status, rural residence, unemployment, lack of previous HPV awareness, and absence of social media use were associated with poor knowledge . Conclusion: Despite relatively high HPV awareness, parental knowledge and vaccine uptake remain insufficient in Tunisia. Targeted education by healthcare professionals, school-based awareness programs, and evidence-based communication strategies are needed to improve HPV vaccine acceptance.

title: Atomistic determination of bending rigidity in the HPV-16 capsid
abstract: The assembly of viral capsids emerges from local interactions between protein building blocks that collectively generate highly ordered shells with defined geometry and robust mechanical properties. However, a quantitative link between atomistic interactions and the macroscopic elastic parameters that determine capsid shape and rigidity has remained elusive. Here, we present an atomistic framework that bridges molecular interactions and continuum-scale mechanics in human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV-16). Using all-atom molecular dynamics simulations with umbrella sampling, we evaluate the potential of mean force governing angular deviations between neighboring L1 pentamers and extract both the preferred interaction angle and the associated bending modulus. We find a clear decoupling between spontaneous curvature of the capsid and bending rigidity. While the optimal interaction angle remains almost invariant across changes in pH and ionic strength, the bending modulus, which is an order of magnitude larger than any previous estimates, is strongly modulated by the electrostatic environment: protonation enhances angular stiffness at low ionic strength, whereas electrostatic screening suppresses this effect at higher salt concentrations. Our results identify inter-capsomer rigidity as a key determinant of capsid size and shape and provide a quantitative framework for linking specific protein–protein interactions to the emergent mechanical properties of self-assembled viral capsids.

abstract_zh: 病毒衣壳的组装是由蛋白质构建块之间的局部相互作用产生的,这些蛋白质构建块共同生成具有明确几何形状和强大机械性能的高度有序的外壳。然而,原子相互作用与决定衣壳形状和刚性的宏观弹性参数之间的定量联系仍然难以捉摸。在这里,我们提出了一个在 人乳头瘤病毒 16 型(HPV-16)中连接分子相互作用和连续尺度力学的原子框架。使用伞形采样的全原子分子动力学模拟,我们评估了控制相邻 L1 五聚体之间角度偏差的平均力的潜力,并提取了首选相互作用角度和相关的弯曲模量。我们发现衣壳的自发曲率和弯曲刚度之间存在明显的脱钩。虽然最佳相互作用角在 pH 值和离子强度变化时几乎保持不变,但弯曲模量比之前的任何估计大一个数量级,并受到静电环境的强烈调节:质子化在低离子强度下增强角刚度,而静电屏蔽在较高盐浓度下抑制这种效应。我们的结果确定衣壳间刚性是衣壳大小和形状的关键决定因素,并提供了将特定蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用与自组装病毒衣壳的新兴机械特性联系起来的定量框架。

title: Immunogenicity of Human Papillomavirus Virus Vaccine in a High-risk and Understudied Group: Female Sex Workers.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Female sex workers (FSW) have multiple sexual partners and are at higher risk of human papillomavirus virus (HPV) infection. They could be a target group for HPV vaccination, but their expected immune response to the HPV vaccine is unclear due to potential exposure to the virus. METHODS: We conducted a pilot study (NCT04590521) in Hai Phong, Vietnam to evaluate HPV vaccine immunogenicity among FSW aged 18-26 years. All participants received the standard 3-dose schedule (0, 2, and 6 months) of the quadrivalent Gardasil vaccine (4vHPV). Cervical swabs were collected at time of vaccination to detect high-risk HPV DNA and cervical abnormalities. Blood samples were collected at baseline and at 2, 3, 6, and 7 months after the first dose to determine neutralizing antibody (nAb) responses to HPV16 and HPV18, as well as related HPV52 and HPV58. RESULTS: A total of 63 FSW with a median age of 23.4 years (IQR, 21.6-25.4 years) were recruited. Prevalence of any high-risk HPV type and HPV16/18 infection at baseline was 28.6% (18/63) and 9.5% (6/63), respectively. Following the first dose, 90% and 55% of individuals were seropositive for HPV16 and HPV18, respectively. By month 7, all participants were seropositive to both HPV16 and HPV18. Higher nAb responses were observed among HPV-DNA-negative participants at baseline compared with HPV-DNA-positive participants after 2 and 3 doses (HPV16, geometric mean ratio [GMR] 2.97 and 1.63, P < .05; HPV18, GMR 2.83 and 1.49, P = .06). CONCLUSIONS: Three doses of 4vHPV elicited robust nAb to HPV16 and HPV18 among FSW. Further studies are needed to evaluate the effectiveness of HPV vaccination in FSW. Clinical Trials Registration.NCT04590521.

title: Comparison of Colorimetric LAMP and PCR for High-risk HPV Detection: Implications for Cervical Cancer Screening
abstract: Objective: Cervical cancer, primarily caused by human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, is commonly detected using polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-based assays. However, these methods are time-consuming and require specialized instrumentation. This study evaluated the diagnostic performance of the loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) assay as a rapid alternative for HPV detection compared with conventional PCR testing. Methods: This study included 933 nonpregnant women aged ≥19 years who underwent HPV testing for cervical cancer screening or follow-up. The HPV panel included 14 high-risk types (16, 18, 31, 33, 35, 39, 45, 51, 52, 56, 58, 59, 66, and 68). Cervical swab samples underwent nucleic acid extraction followed by LAMP amplification using type-specific primers. Reactions were performed at 63 °C for 35 minutes, and results were interpreted colorimetrically (blue for positive, purple for negative). Results: Compared with PCR, the LAMP assay showed a sensitivity of 97.8% (95% CI: 94.4–100.0) for HPV types 16 and 18 and 100.0% (95% CI: 98.8–100.0) for the remaining high-risk types. Specificity across all types was 100.0% (95% CI: 98.8–100.0). The overall diagnostic accuracy was 99.5% (95% CI: 99.0–100.0). When all 14 HPV types were analyzed collectively, clinical sensitivity and specificity were 99.4% and 100.0%, respectively. Conclusions: The LAMP assay provides a rapid, simple, and accurate method for HPV detection and may serve as a useful point-of-care screening tool, particularly in resource-limited settings.
journal: Journal of Lower Genital Tract Disease

source_records.abstract: Objective: Cervical cancer, primarily caused by human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, is commonly detected using polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-based assays. However, these methods are time-consuming and require specialized instrumentation. This study evaluated the diagnostic performance of the loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) assay as a rapid alternative for HPV detection compared with conventional PCR testing. Methods: This study included 933 nonpregnant women aged ≥19 years who underwent HPV testing for cervical cancer screening or follow-up. The HPV panel included 14 high-risk types (16, 18, 31, 33, 35, 39, 45, 51, 52, 56, 58, 59, 66, and 68). Cervical swab samples underwent nucleic acid extraction followed by LAMP amplification using type-specific primers. Reactions were performed at 63 °C for 35 minutes, and results were interpreted colorimetrically (blue for positive, purple for negative). Results: Compared with PCR, the LAMP assay showed a sensitivity of 97.8% (95% CI: 94.4–100.0) for HPV types 16 and 18 and 100.0% (95% CI: 98.8–100.0) for the remaining high-risk types. Specificity across all types was 100.0% (95% CI: 98.8–100.0). The overall diagnostic accuracy was 99.5% (95% CI: 99.0–100.0). When all 14 HPV types were analyzed collectively, clinical sensitivity and specificity were 99.4% and 100.0%, respectively. Conclusions: The LAMP assay provides a rapid, simple, and accurate method for HPV detection and may serve as a useful point-of-care screening tool, particularly in resource-limited settings.

analysis.summary_en: This study compares the diagnostic performance of the colorimetric LAMP assay with conventional PCR for detecting high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) types in cervical cancer screening. The LAMP assay demonstrated high sensitivity and specificity for HPV types 16, 18, and other high-risk types, with overall diagnostic accuracy of 99.5%. The authors suggest that the LAMP assay could serve as a rapid, simple, and accurate point-of-care screening tool, particularly in resource-limited settings. The study was conducted in a single center with 933 nonpregnant women aged ≥19 years. The results indicate that the LAMP assay is a promising alternative to PCR for HPV detection. However, the study's limited generalizability and single-center design may affect the confidence in its findings. The evidence supports a high confidence in the assay's performance for the target HPV types.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 宫颈癌 主要由 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染引起,通常使用基于聚合酶链反应 (PCR) 的检测进行检测。然而,这些方法非常耗时并且需要专门的仪器。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了环介导等温扩增 (LAMP) 检测作为 HPV 检测的快速替代方法与传统 PCR 检测相比的诊断性能。这项研究纳入了 933 名年龄≥19 岁的非孕妇,她们接受了 HPV 检测以进行 宫颈癌 筛查或随访。
elements_zh.methods: HPV 样本包括 14 种高危类型(16、18、31、33、35、39、45、51、52、56、58、59、66 和 68)。宫颈拭子样本经过核酸提取,然后使用类型特异性引物进行 LAMP 扩增。反应在 63 °C 下进行 35 分钟,并通过比色法解释结果(蓝色表示阳性,紫色表示阴性)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: LAMP 检测提供了一种快速、简单且准确的 HPV 检测方法,可作为有用的护理点筛查工具,特别是在资源有限的环境中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,LAMP 检测可能是 宫颈癌 筛查的一个有价值的工具,特别是在基于 PCR 的方法不易获得的环境中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在一个中心进行的,可能无法推广到其他人群。证据确凿,与 PCR 相比,LAMP 检测具有较高的灵敏度和特异性。

abstract_zh: 目的:宫颈癌 主要由 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染引起,通常使用基于聚合酶链反应 (PCR) 的检测方法进行检测。然而,这些方法非常耗时并且需要专门的仪器。本研究评估了环介导等温扩增 (LAMP) 检测作为 HPV 检测的快速替代方法与传统 PCR 检测相比的诊断性能。方法:本研究纳入了 933 名年龄≥19 岁的非孕妇,她们接受了 HPV 检测以进行 宫颈癌 筛查或随访。HPV 样本包括 14 种高危类型(16、18、31、33、35、39、45、51、52、56、58、59、66 和 68)。宫颈拭子样本经过核酸提取,然后使用类型特异性引物进行 LAMP 扩增。反应在 63 °C 下进行 35 分钟,并通过比色法解释结果(蓝色表示阳性,紫色表示阴性)。结果:与 PCR 相比,LAMP 检测对 HPV 16 型和 18 型的敏感性为 97.8%(95% CI:94.4-100.0),对其余高危型的敏感性为 100.0%(95% CI:98.8-100.0)。所有类型的特异性均为 100.0%(95% CI:98.8–100.0)。总体诊断准确率为 99.5%(95% CI:99.0–100.0)。当对所有 14 种 HPV 类型进行汇总分析时,临床敏感性和特异性分别为 99.4% 和 100.0%。结论:LAMP 检测提供了一种快速、简单且准确的 HPV 检测方法,可作为有用的护理点筛查工具,特别是在资源有限的环境中。

title: '...but look how many lives would have been saved if this was available then' Exploring the acceptability of future Human Papillomavirus self-sampling, and the barriers and facilitators of cervical cancer screening for those with intellectual disabilities in Scotland.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer screening attendance among women with intellectual disabilities (ID) in Scotland is approximately 30%, significantly below the general population rate of 69% and the WHO's recommended 70% target. HPV self-sampling could provide a more accessible screening option for this underserved population. This study aimed to understand the views and experiences of women with ID regarding cervical cancer screening and the acceptability of HPV self-sampling. METHODS: A qualitative study using focus groups was conducted with women with ID who attended third-sector community groups across Scotland, along with their carers. Four focus groups were held between September and October 2024, with a total of 13 participants (11 women with ID, 2 carers). Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. RESULTS: Five main themes emerged: (1) National Health Service (NHS) communication as a source of distress; (2) power imbalances between health care providers and women with ID: feeling unheard, dismissed and out of control; (3) enduring consequences of inadequate care; (4) past trauma shapes future avoidance; and (5) self-sampling as a pathway to empowerment. Participants demonstrated high acceptability of self-sampling, viewing it as a potential solution to overcome barriers to traditional screening. CONCLUSION: This research reveals significant systemic inadequacies in current cervical cancer screening services for women with ID, whilst highlighting self-sampling's transformative potential. Successful implementation requires comprehensive accessible information, enhanced health care professional training and trauma-informed care approaches. Self-sampling could significantly advance health equity goals whilst improving health care outcomes for this underserved population.

abstract_zh: 背景:苏格兰智障女性 (ID) 的 宫颈癌 筛查出勤率约为 30%,远低于总人口 69% 的比率和世界卫生组织建议的 70% 目标。HPV 自我采样可以为这一服务不足的人群提供更方便的筛查选择。本研究旨在了解患有 ID 的女性对 宫颈癌 筛查以及 HPV 自我采样的可接受性的看法和经验。方法:利用焦点小组对参与苏格兰第三部门社区团体的智障女性及其护理人员进行了一项定性研究。2024 年 9 月至 10 月期间举办了四次焦点小组,共有 13 名参与者(11 名患有智力障碍的女性,2 名护理人员)。使用反思性主题分析对数据进行分析。结果:出现了五个主题:(1) 国家卫生服务 (NHS) 沟通是痛苦的根源;(2) 医疗保健提供者和智障妇女之间的权力失衡:感觉被忽视、被忽视和失控;(3) 护理不足造成的持久后果;(4)过去的创伤塑造了未来的回避;(5) 自我抽样作为赋权的途径。参与者表现出对自我采样的高度接受度,将其视为克服传统筛查障碍的潜在解决方案。结论:这项研究揭示了当前 宫颈癌 针对 ID 女性的筛查服务存在显着的系统性缺陷,同时强调了自我采样的变革潜力。成功的实施需要全面的可获取信息、加强的医疗保健专业培训和创伤知情护理方法。自我采样可以显着推进健康公平目标,同时改善这一服务不足人群的医疗保健结果。

title: Human host factors Secretory leukocyte protease inhibitor and Annexin A2 modulate the presence of human papillomavirus DNA, but not Epstein-Barr virus, in nasopharyngeal carcinoma from non-endemic regions.
abstract: BACKGROUND: The human host factors Secretory leukocyte protease inhibitor (SLPI) and Annexin A2 (AnxA2) influence susceptibility of epithelial cells to human papillomavirus (HPV)-infections. Although nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) is classically associated with Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), increasing evidence indicates that a subset of NPCs from non-endemic regions harbours HPV DNA, suggesting biological overlap with HPV-associated head and neck cancers. Therefore, we studied whether this host-driven mechanism also shapes NPC-biology. METHODS: Retrospectively 44 histopathological confirmed NPC cases from non-endemic German regions were analysed. Nucleic acids were extracted from FFPE tissue. DNA was used for PCR-based detection of HPV and EBV, RNA was used for RT-PCR detection of HPV transcriptional activity and RT-qPCR for quantification of SLPI- and AnxA2-expression. Associations between viral-status, host factor expression, and clinicopathological parameters were assessed using Fisher's exact test, Student's t-test, and one way-ANOVA. RESULTS: EBV was detected in 65.9% cases, HPV-DNA in 29.6%, all harboured HPV16-DNA; none expressed HPV16-RNA. EBV-status had no effect on SLPI-expression and was associated with lower AnxA2-levels. HPV-presence was associated with significantly lower SLPI- and higher AnxA2-expression, indicating a permissive epithelial environment for viral entry. Combined-status analyses confirmed that host factor expression paralleled the HPV-DNA- but not EBV-status. CONCLUSIONS: These findings indicate that in NPC from non-endemic regions, SLPI- and AnxA2-expression defines a host microenvironment permissive for HPV-DNA, whereas EBV-status appears independent of these factors. As no HPV-RNA was detected, these results reflect HPV-presence rather than transcriptionally active infection, suggesting that these host factors may govern viral entry without determining subsequent infection.

Although nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) is classically associated with Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), increasing evidence indicates that a subset of NPCs from non-endemic regions harbours HPV DNA, suggesting biological overlap with HPV-associated head and neck cancers. Therefore, we studied whether this host-driven mechanism also shapes NPC-biology. METHODS: Retrospectively 44 histopathological confirmed NPC cases from non-endemic German regions were analysed. Nucleic acids were extracted from FFPE tissue. DNA was used for PCR-based detection of HPV and EBV, RNA was used for RT-PCR detection of HPV transcriptional activity and RT-qPCR for quantification of SLPI- and AnxA2-expression. Associations between viral-status, host factor expression, and clinicopathological parameters were assessed using Fisher's exact test, Student's t-test, and one way-ANOVA. RESULTS: EBV was detected in 65.9% cases, HPV-DNA in 29.6%, all harboured HPV16-DNA; none expressed HPV16-RNA. EBV-status had no effect on SLPI-expression and was associated with lower AnxA2-levels. HPV-presence was associated with significantly lower SLPI- and higher AnxA2-expression, indicating a permissive epithelial environment for viral entry. Combined-status analyses confirmed that host factor expression paralleled the HPV-DNA- but not EBV-status. CONCLUSIONS: These findings indicate that in NPC from non-endemic regions, SLPI- and AnxA2-expression defines a host microenvironment permissive for HPV-DNA, whereas EBV-status appears independent of these factors. As no HPV-RNA was detected, these results reflect HPV-presence rather than transcriptionally active infection, suggesting that these host factors may govern viral entry without determining subsequent infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究探讨了 宿主 因子分泌性白细胞蛋白酶抑制剂 (SLPI) 和膜联蛋白 A2 (AnxA2) 是否调节非流行地区鼻咽癌 (NPC) 中 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 的存在,尽管在非流行地区,尽管与 Epstein-Barr 病毒 (EBV) 存在经典关联,但已检测到 HPV DNA。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用福尔马林固定石蜡包埋 (FFPE) 组织样本回顾性分析了来自德国非流行地区的 44 例组织病理学确诊的鼻咽癌病例。
elements_zh.methods: 从 FFPE 组织中提取核酸,DNA 用于 PCR 检测 HPV 和 EBV,RNA 用于 RT-PCR 检测 HPV 转录活性,RT-qPCR 用于定量 SLPI 和 AnxA2 表达。使用 Fisher 精确检验、Student t 检验和单向方差分析评估病毒状态、宿主 因子表达和临床病理学参数之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 在病例中,EBV检出率为65.9%,HPV DNA检出率为29.6%,且所有HPV阳性病例均携带HPV16 DNA;但均未检测到HPV16 RNA表达。HPV感染与SLPI表达显著降低及AnxA2表达显著升高相关,而EBV感染状态对SLPI无影响,并与AnxA2表达水平降低相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,SLPI 和 AnxA2 表达定义了允许非流行地区 NPC 中 HPV DNA 存在的 宿主 微环境,而 EBV 状态似乎独立于这些因素,突出了一种针对 HPV 的新型 宿主 病毒相互作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,宿主 因子 SLPI 和 AnxA2 可能会影响 HPV 进入 NPC 上皮细胞,可能为未来的 监测 或针对 HPV 相关癌症中这些因子的治疗策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计、样本量小和缺乏 HPV RNA 表达而受到限制,这将结论限制为 HPV 存在而不是活动性感染,需要谨慎解释和更大规模的前瞻性研究。

abstract_zh: 背景:人类 宿主 因子分泌性白细胞蛋白酶抑制剂 (SLPI) 和膜联蛋白 A2 (AnxA2) 影响上皮细胞对 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染的易感性。尽管鼻咽癌 (NPC) 通常与 Epstein-Barr 病毒 (EBV) 有关,但越来越多的证据表明,来自非流行地区的一部分 NPC 含有 HPV DNA,这表明与 HPV 相关的头颈癌存在生物学重叠。因此,我们研究了这种 宿主 驱动机制是否也塑造了 NPC 生物学。方法:回顾性分析来自德国非流行地区的 44 例组织病理学确诊的鼻咽癌病例。从 FFPE 组织中提取核酸。DNA 用于基于 PCR 的 HPV 和 EBV 检测,RNA 用于 RT-PCR 检测 HPV 转录活性,RT-qPCR 用于定量 SLPI 和 AnxA2 表达。使用 Fisher 精确检验、Student t 检验和单向方差分析评估病毒状态、宿主 因子表达和临床病理学参数之间的关联。结果:EBV检出率为65.9%,HPV-DNA检出率为29.6%,全部检出HPV16-DNA;没有一个表达 HPV16-RNA。EBV 状态对 SLPI 表达没有影响,并且与较低的 AnxA2 水平相关。HPV 的存在与显着较低的 SLPI 表达和较高的 AnxA2 表达相关,表明上皮环境适合病毒进入。组合状态分析证实,宿主 因子表达与 HPV-DNA 平行,但与 EBV 状态不平行。结论:这些发现表明,在非流行地区的鼻咽癌中,SLPI 和 AnxA2 表达定义了允许 HPV-DNA 的 宿主 微环境,而 EBV 状态似乎与这些因素无关。由于没有检测到 HPV-RNA,这些结果反映了 HPV 的存在,而不是转录活跃的感染,表明这些 宿主 因子可能控制病毒进入,而不决定随后的感染。
