title: Simultaneous Administration of Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Vaccine With Other Recommended Vaccines Among Adolescents Aged 13-17 years, National Immunization Survey-Teen (NIS-Teen), United States, 2023.
abstract: PURPOSE: To investigate the percent of adolescents who receive human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine with one or more other vaccines recommended for adolescents in a single medical visit. METHODS: Data from the 2023 National Immunization Survey-Teen were analyzed. Timing of receipt of HPV vaccine, tetanus, diphtheria, and acellular pertussis vaccine (Tdap), quadrivalent meningococcal conjugate vaccine (MenACWY), and influenza vaccine was assessed using provider-reported vaccination histories. RESULTS: In 2023, among adolescents aged 13-17 years, 69.5% received HPV vaccine with one or more other vaccines recommended for adolescents in a single medical visit. In addition, 47.8% received specifically HPV vaccine, Tdap, and MenACWY together in a single medical visit. DISCUSSION: The HPV vaccine is commonly given with other vaccines recommended for adolescents in a single medical visit. These findings demonstrate variation in simultaneous vaccination patterns, suggesting that flexibility in the recommended adolescent vaccination schedule allows for different approaches to vaccination across clinical settings and family preferences while maintaining adherence to the recommended schedule.
journal: The Journal of adolescent health : official publication of the Society for Adolescent Medicine

source_body_en: PURPOSE: To investigate the percent of adolescents who receive human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine with one or more other vaccines recommended for adolescents in a single medical visit. METHODS: Data from the 2023 National Immunization Survey-Teen were analyzed. Timing of receipt of HPV vaccine, tetanus, diphtheria, and acellular pertussis vaccine (Tdap), quadrivalent meningococcal conjugate vaccine (MenACWY), and influenza vaccine was assessed using provider-reported vaccination histories. RESULTS: In 2023, among adolescents aged 13-17 years, 69.5% received HPV vaccine with one or more other vaccines recommended for adolescents in a single medical visit. In addition, 47.8% received specifically HPV vaccine, Tdap, and MenACWY together in a single medical visit. DISCUSSION: The HPV vaccine is commonly given with other vaccines recommended for adolescents in a single medical visit. These findings demonstrate variation in simultaneous vaccination patterns, suggesting that flexibility in the recommended adolescent vaccination schedule allows for different approaches to vaccination across clinical settings and family preferences while maintaining adherence to the recommended schedule.

title: Knowledge and awareness regarding human papillomavirus and its association with oropharyngeal cancer among the general population in Makkah, Saudi Arabia: a cross-sectional study
abstract: Background Human papillomavirus (HPV) represents the most prevalent sexually transmitted infection globally and is recognized as a principal etiological agent of anogenital, cervical and oropharyngeal cancers (OPC). Notably, HPV serves as a significant risk factor for OPC, the incidence of which has been rising worldwide in recent years. This study was conducted to assess the level of awareness and knowledge regarding HPV and its association with OPC among residents of Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Materials and methods All adults (aged 18 years and over, n = 420) were surveyed cross-sectionally in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Data were collected using structured and self-administered questionnaires online. The instrument included sociodemographic data, and questions about awareness and knowledge of HPV infection and its association with OPC. Descriptive statistics were used for all the variables and there were multiple choice questions to which the answers were ‘Yes’, ‘No’ and ‘Do not know’. Results The adults participated were a total of 420. About half of the respondents (51.7%) were previously heard of HPV and only 21.4% had encountered an awareness campaign about HPV and OPC. Over half (53.6%) correctly identified HPV as not a bacterial infection, while fewer recognized HPV as being contagious (43.1%) and that it could be transmitted through sexual contact (44.3%). Knowledge of HPV prevention was variable; 67.9% recognized that HPV vaccination can reduce the risk of HPV infection, but only 42.4% were aware that vaccines are available to help prevent HPV infection. Also, awareness of the symptoms of OPC and risk factors were inconsistent, with the most common being oral lesions and neck lump, and the most identified risk factors were smoking and alcohol consumption. Most participants (88.1%) reported insufficient knowledge about HPV and OPC and expressed a need for additional information, with social media identified as the preferred strategy for increasing public awareness (38.1%). Conclusion The findings demonstrate important gaps in public knowledge and awareness of HPV, its association with OPC, and HPV prevention among adults in Makkah. Targeted educational interventions and public awareness campaigns are needed to improve understanding of HPV transmission, vaccination, and OPC prevention. Given that most participants expressed a need for additional information, digital platforms, particularly social media, may provide an effective approach for delivering public health education.

title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯麦加普通人群对 人乳头瘤病毒 及其与口咽癌关联的知识和认识:一项横断面研究
source_body_en: Background Human papillomavirus (HPV) represents the most prevalent sexually transmitted infection globally and is recognized as a principal etiological agent of anogenital, cervical and oropharyngeal cancers (OPC). Notably, HPV serves as a significant risk factor for OPC, the incidence of which has been rising worldwide in recent years. This study was conducted to assess the level of awareness and knowledge regarding HPV and its association with OPC among residents of Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Materials and methods All adults (aged 18 years and over, n = 420) were surveyed cross-sectionally in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Data were collected using structured and self-administered questionnaires online. The instrument included sociodemographic data, and questions about awareness and knowledge of HPV infection and its association with OPC. Descriptive statistics were used for all the variables and there were multiple choice questions to which the answers were ‘Yes’, ‘No’ and ‘Do not know’. Results The adults participated were a total of 420. About half of the respondents (51.7%) were previously heard of HPV and only 21.4% had encountered an awareness campaign about HPV and OPC. Over half (53.6%) correctly identified HPV as not a bacterial infection, while fewer recognized HPV as being contagious (43.1%) and that it could be transmitted through sexual contact (44.3%). Knowledge of HPV prevention was variable; 67.9% recognized that HPV vaccination can reduce the risk of HPV infection, but only 42.4% were aware that vaccines are available to help prevent HPV infection. Also, awareness of the symptoms of OPC and risk factors were inconsistent, with the most common being oral lesions and neck lump, and the most identified risk factors were smoking and alcohol consumption. Most participants (88.1%) reported insufficient knowledge about HPV and OPC and expressed a need for additional information, with social media identified as the preferred strategy for increasing public awareness (38.1%). Conclusion The findings demonstrate important gaps in public knowledge and awareness of HPV, its association with OPC, and HPV prevention among adults in Makkah. Targeted educational interventions and public awareness campaigns are needed to improve understanding of HPV transmission, vaccination, and OPC prevention. Given that most participants expressed a need for additional information, digital platforms, particularly social media, may provide an effective approach for delivering public health education.
abstract_zh: 背景 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 代表全球最流行的性传播感染,并被认为是肛门生殖器癌、宫颈癌和口咽癌 (OPC) 的主要病原体。值得注意的是,HPV是OPC的一个重要危险因素,其发病率近年来在全球范围内不断上升。本研究旨在评估沙特阿拉伯麦加居民对 HPV 及其与 OPC 的关联的认识和知识水平。材料和方法 对沙特阿拉伯麦加的所有成年人(18 岁及以上,n = 420)进行了横断面调查。使用结构化和自填式在线问卷收集数据。该工具包括社会人口统计数据以及有关 HPV 感染及其与 OPC 关联的认识和知识的问题。所有变量均使用描述性统计,并且存在多项选择题,答案为“是”、“否”和“不知道”。结果 参与的成年人共有 420 名。大约一半的受访者 (51.7%) 以前听说过 HPV,只有 21.4% 曾参加过有关 HPV 和 OPC 的宣传活动。超过一半 (53.6%) 的人正确识别 HPV 不是细菌感染,而很少有人认为 HPV 具有传染性 (43.1%),并且可以通过性接触传播 (44.3%)。对 HPV 预防的了解各不相同;67.9%的人认识到HPV 疫苗接种可以降低HPV感染的风险,但只有42.4%的人知道疫苗可以帮助预防HPV感染。此外,人们对 OPC 症状和危险因素的认识也不一致,最常见的是口腔病变和颈部肿块,最常见的危险因素是吸烟和饮酒。大多数参与者 (88.1%) 表示对 HPV 和 OPC 的了解不足,并表示需要更多信息,社交媒体被认为是提高公众意识的首选策略 (38.1%)。结论 研究结果表明,麦加成年人对 HPV、其与 OPC 的关系以及 HPV 预防方面的公众知识和认识存在重大差距。需要有针对性的教育干预和公众意识活动,以提高对 HPV 传播、疫苗接种 和 OPC 预防的了解。鉴于大多数参与者表示需要更多信息,数字平台,特别是社交媒体,可能为提供公共卫生教育提供有效的方法。

title: Immune Absence as a Proposed Framework for Delayed Relapse After Curative-Intent Treatment in Human Papillomavirus-Associated Cervical Cancer
abstract: Delayed relapse after curative-intent treatment remains difficult to explain and predict in human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated cervical cancer, including after periods of sustained remission with undetectable circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) or circulating HPV DNA. This limitation of tumor-centered surveillance demands the evaluation of immune parameters alongside tumor-derived biomarkers. We propose “immune absence” as a hypothesis-generating, operational framework referring to the sustained reduction or non-persistence of pre-specified tumor-reactive T-cell receptor (TCR) clonotypes in serial peripheral blood samples, obtained during minimal residual disease states in which antigen exposure may be limited or intermittent. We hypothesize that this longitudinal pattern may precede molecular or clinical evidence of relapse in a subset of patients and coexist with established mechanisms, such as tumor evolution, immune escape, T-cell dysfunction, and therapeutic resistance. Integrating serial ctDNA or circulating HPV DNA measurements with tumor-reactive TCR clonotype dynamics may provide complementary information on residual tumor burden and the persistence of circulating tumor-reactive T-cell responses. Peripheral blood TCR non-detection does not establish complete loss of anti-tumor immunity and may reflect compartmentalized immunity, clonal replacement, antigenic evolution, or assay limitations. Prospective longitudinal studies are required to establish the prognostic value of this framework before clinical use.

title_zh: 免疫缺失作为 人乳头瘤病毒 相关 宫颈癌 中治疗意图 治疗 后延迟复发的拟议框架
source_body_en: Delayed relapse after curative-intent treatment remains difficult to explain and predict in human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated cervical cancer, including after periods of sustained remission with undetectable circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) or circulating HPV DNA. This limitation of tumor-centered surveillance demands the evaluation of immune parameters alongside tumor-derived biomarkers. We propose “immune absence” as a hypothesis-generating, operational framework referring to the sustained reduction or non-persistence of pre-specified tumor-reactive T-cell receptor (TCR) clonotypes in serial peripheral blood samples, obtained during minimal residual disease states in which antigen exposure may be limited or intermittent. We hypothesize that this longitudinal pattern may precede molecular or clinical evidence of relapse in a subset of patients and coexist with established mechanisms, such as tumor evolution, immune escape, T-cell dysfunction, and therapeutic resistance. Integrating serial ctDNA or circulating HPV DNA measurements with tumor-reactive TCR clonotype dynamics may provide complementary information on residual tumor burden and the persistence of circulating tumor-reactive T-cell responses. Peripheral blood TCR non-detection does not establish complete loss of anti-tumor immunity and may reflect compartmentalized immunity, clonal replacement, antigenic evolution, or assay limitations. Prospective longitudinal studies are required to establish the prognostic value of this framework before clinical use.
abstract_zh: 在 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 相关的 人乳头瘤病毒 中,治疗目的 治疗 后的延迟复发仍然难以解释和预测,包括在循环肿瘤 DNA (ctDNA) 或循环 HPV DNA 检测不到的持续缓解期之后。以肿瘤为中心的 监测 的这种局限性需要评估免疫参数以及肿瘤衍生的生物标志物。我们提出“免疫缺失”作为一个假设生成的操作框架,指的是在抗原暴露可能有限或间歇性的微小残留疾病状态下获得的连续外周血样本中预先指定的肿瘤反应性T细胞受体(TCR)克隆型的持续减少或不持续。我们假设这种纵向模式可能先于部分患者复发的分子或临床证据,并与既定机制共存,例如肿瘤 进化、免疫逃逸、T 细胞功能障碍和治疗耐药。将连续 ctDNA 或循环 HPV DNA 测量与肿瘤反应性 TCR 克隆型动态相结合,可以提供有关残余肿瘤负荷和循环肿瘤反应性 T 细胞反应持续性的补充信息。未检测到外周血 TCR 并不表明抗肿瘤免疫力完全丧失,可能反映区室化免疫、克隆替代、抗原 进化 或检测限制。在临床使用之前需要进行前瞻性纵向研究来确定该框架的预后价值。

title: Experimental Analysis of HPV16 L1/L2 Chimeric VLP Internalization by Human Peripheral Blood Leukocytes
abstract: Human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16) is a major etiological agent of cervical and other epithelial cancers, yet the mechanisms underlying host–pathogen interactions remain incompletely understood. In this study, we investigated the responses of human peripheral blood leukocytes to engineered HPV16 L1/L2 chimeric virus-like particles (VLPs), produced in suspension by HEK 293-F cells. These VLPs were designed to mimic native viral structures while incorporating chimeric features that enhance stability and immunogenicity. Through experimental assays, we characterized leukocyte engagement, primarily involving leukocyte phenotyping, VLP internalization, confocal colocalization, and endocytic pathway analyses. We demonstrated that recombinant L1/L2 proteins assembled into structured VLPs capable of interacting with mononuclear cells, including lymphocytes and monocytes, but not with polymorphonuclear cells, such as neutrophils, eosinophils and basophils. Uptake occurred via the CD71 transferrin receptor-mediated pathway, in addition to other endocytic routes analyzed, as confirmed by blockage assays using chlorpromazine, rCTB, filipin, nystatin, liquemine, and sodium azide. Confocal colocalization and endocytic pathway analyses further supported receptor-mediated uptake. These findings demonstrate that HPV16 L1/L2 chimeric VLPs interact with and are internalized by human peripheral blood mononuclear cells through CD71-associated and other endocytic pathways. The study provides new insights into HPV16 VLP–leukocyte interactions and contributes to a better understanding of the cellular mechanisms involved in VLP uptake, which may be relevant for future studies on HPV biology and VLP-based vaccine development.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及通过实验测定来表征白细胞与 HEK 293-F 细胞悬浮液中产生的 HPV16 L1/L2 嵌合 VLP 的结合。这些 VLP 旨在模仿天然病毒结构,同时结合增强稳定性和免疫原性的嵌合特征。该研究重点关注人外周血单核细胞,包括淋巴细胞和单核细胞,但不包括多形核细胞。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用白细胞表型分析、VLP 内化、共聚焦共定位和内吞途径分析来表征相互作用。使用氯丙嗪、rCTB、菲律宾素、制霉菌素、利克明和叠氮化钠通过阻断测定评估摄取,以确认 CD71 转铁蛋白受体介导的和其他内吞途径。
elements_zh.main_results: 组装成结构化 VLP 的重组 L1/L2 蛋白可与单核细胞(包括淋巴细胞和单核细胞)相互作用,但不与多形核细胞(如中性粒细胞、嗜酸性粒细胞和嗜碱性粒细胞)相互作用。摄取通过 CD71 转铁蛋白受体介导的途径以及其他内吞途径发生。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为未来有关 HPV 生物学和基于 VLP 的 疫苗 开发的研究提供信息,特别是了解这些颗粒如何与免疫细胞相互作用并被免疫细胞吸收。

title: Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices (KAP) Regarding Sexually Transmitted Infections, Human Papillomavirus, and HPV-Related Oropharyngeal Cancer Among Italian Adolescents: A Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Background/Objectives: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is now responsible for the majority of oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas (OPSCCs), an HPV-related cancer of direct relevance to the dental profession; oral-health providers may be well-positioned to perform routine oral examination, recognize suspicious signs, refer appropriately, and educate patients about HPV-related oropharyngeal cancer and HPV vaccination. This study assessed knowledge, attitudes and practices regarding sexually transmitted infections (STIs), HPV, HIV/AIDS and HPV-related oral and oropharyngeal cancer among secondary-school students in Apulia, Italy, with particular attention to the dental setting. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted by the University of Foggia among 1224 students from three secondary schools at the end of the 2025/2026 school year) using a self-administered 108-item questionnaire. A 63-item composite knowledge score was computed; “don’t know” answers were scored as incorrect and adequate knowledge defined a priori as ≥60% (Bloom’s cut-off). The minimum required sample (737) was derived using Cochran’s formula adjusted for a cluster-sampling design effect. Results: Overall knowledge was low (mean 28.5%, SD 18.2); only 5% reached the ≥60% threshold (Bloom’s cut-off). Only 14.8% of students were aware that HPV can cause oropharyngeal cancer, the lowest figure among all oncogenic outcomes assessed and significantly lower in boys (11.2%) than girls (17.3%; p = 0.003), despite boys carrying the higher OPSCC risk. Knowledge was independently associated with female sex, age and sexual experience. Despite poor knowledge, 61.2% of students would like to receive the HPV vaccine. Conclusions: The dental visit may represent an under-used opportunity to address this oral-cancer-prevention knowledge gap; the integration of oral-health professionals into school-based and clinical HPV-prevention strategies is a plausible public-health implication.

analysis.research_question_and_background: HPV is increasingly implicated in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas, a disease relevant to dental practice, yet gaps persist in adolescents' knowledge about HPV and its oncogenic risks. The study aimed to evaluate knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding STIs, HPV, and HPV-related oropharyngeal cancer among Italian secondary-school students.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 1,224 secondary-school students in Apulia, Italy, at the end of the 2025/2026 school year using a self-administered 108-item questionnaire.
analysis.methods: A 63-item composite knowledge score was computed with “don’t know” answers scored as incorrect and adequate knowledge defined as ≥60% (Bloom’s cut-off). The minimum required sample size of 737 was calculated using Cochran’s formula adjusted for a cluster-sampling design effect.
analysis.main_results: Overall knowledge was low (mean 28.5%, SD 18.2), with only 5% reaching the ≥60% threshold. Only 14.8% of students were aware that HPV can cause oropharyngeal cancer, significantly lower in boys (11.2%) than girls (17.3%; p = 0.003). Knowledge was independently associated with female sex, age, and sexual experience.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as indicating a critical knowledge gap about HPV and its oropharyngeal cancer risk, particularly among boys who face higher disease risk. They highlight the potential role of dental professionals in addressing this gap through education and prevention strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that school-based and clinical HPV-prevention strategies could benefit from integrating oral-health professionals to improve awareness and vaccination uptake among adolescents.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s cross-sectional design limits causal inference, and the reliance on self-reported data may introduce bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to the large sample size but constrained by the abstract-only scope and lack of detailed statistical reporting.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study assessed knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding sexually transmitted infections, HPV, and HPV-related oropharyngeal cancer among 1,224 Italian secondary-school students. Using a 108-item questionnaire, the authors found critically low HPV knowledge (mean 28.5%), with only 5% meeting an adequate knowledge threshold (≥60%). Awareness that HPV causes oropharyngeal cancer was particularly low (14.8%), especially among boys (11.2% vs. 17.3% in girls; p = 0.003). Knowledge correlated with female sex, older age, and sexual experience. Despite poor knowledge, 61.2% expressed willingness to receive the HPV vaccine. The authors propose leveraging dental visits to address HPV-related cancer prevention gaps, emphasizing the role of oral-health professionals in school-based and clinical HPV-prevention strategies.

abstract_zh: 背景/目标:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 目前是大多数口咽鳞状细胞癌 (OPSCC) 的罪魁祸首,这是一种与牙科行业直接相关的 HPV 相关癌症;口腔保健提供者可能有能力进行常规口腔检查、识别可疑体征、适当转诊并对患者进行有关 HPV 相关口咽癌和 HPV 疫苗接种 的教育。本研究评估了意大利普利亚中学生对性传播感染 (STI)、HPV、HIV/AIDS 以及 HPV 相关口腔和口咽癌的知识、态度和做法,特别关注牙科环境。方法:福贾大学在 2025/2026 学年结束时对来自三所中学的 1224 名学生进行了一项横断面研究,使用了包含 108 项的自填问卷。计算了 63 项综合知识得分;“不知道”的答案被评分为不正确,并且先验的充分知识定义为 ≥60%(布卢姆截止值)。所需的最小样本 (737) 是使用针对整群抽样设计效果进行调整的 Cochran 公式得出的。结果:总体知识水平较低(平均 28.5%,SD 18.2);只有 5% 达到 ≥60% 阈值(布卢姆截止值)。只有 14.8% 的学生知道 HPV 可导致口咽癌,这是所有评估的致癌结果中最低的数字,并且男孩 (11.2%) 显着低于女孩 (17.3%;p = 0.003),尽管男孩 OPSCC 风险较高。知识与女性性别、年龄和性经历独立相关。尽管知识匮乏,但 61.2% 的学生希望接受 HPV 疫苗。结论:看牙医可能是弥补口腔癌预防知识差距的一个未被充分利用的机会;将口腔保健专业人员纳入学校和临床 HPV 预防策略可能对公共卫生产生影响。

analysis_zh.main_results: 总体知识水平较低(平均 28.5%,SD 18.2),只有 5% 的人达到 ≥60% 的阈值。只有 14.8% 的学生知道 HPV 可导致口咽癌,男孩 (11.2%) 的知晓率显着低于女孩 (17.3%;p = 0.003)。知识与女性性别、年龄和性经历独立相关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为表明人们对 HPV 及其口咽癌风险存在严重的知识差距,特别是在面临较高疾病风险的男孩中。他们强调了牙科专业人员通过教育和预防策略来解决这一差距的潜在作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,基于学校和临床的 HPV 预防策略可以受益于口腔健康专业人员的整合,以提高青少年的认识和 疫苗接种 的吸收。

title: Human papillomavirus infection and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease: a comprehensive review of epidemiological evidence, molecular mechanisms, and vaccination-mediated protection
abstract: Emerging epidemiological evidence indicates that persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) genotypes is independently associated with elevated atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk, challenging traditional paradigms of cardiovascular risk assessment. This review synthesises current observational data on this association, explores the potential inflammatory, immune, and metabolic mechanisms that may connect HPV to atherogenesis, and evaluates the emerging evidence for cardiovascular protection conferred by HPV vaccination. Large cohort studies report significantly elevated risks of myocardial infarction, stroke, and cardiovascular mortality among women with high-risk HPV infection, independent of conventional risk factors. Mechanistically, HPV oncoproteins E6 and E7 activate nuclear factor-κB (NF-κB)-mediated inflammatory cascades, induce endothelial dysfunction through p53 degradation, and establish a pro-atherogenic systemic inflammatory milieu characterized by elevated interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α). Preliminary retrospective analyses further indicate that HPV vaccination is linked to a reduced incidence of new-onset cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events, although healthy-user bias and residual confounding limit causal interpretation. Despite these intriguing signals, the bulk of evidence is derived from cross-sectional and retrospective designs, and the direct demonstration of a causal link remains absent. We discuss critical methodological challenges—including confounding by sexual behaviour, socioeconomic status, and co-infections—and outline a roadmap for prospective cohort studies, mechanistic investigations, and rigorous risk-stratification research. Clarifying the nature of the HPV–CVD relationship could open novel avenues for the primary prevention of atherosclerotic disease through vaccination programmes.

abstract_zh: 新的流行病学证据表明,高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 基因型的持续感染与动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病 (CVD) 风险升高独立相关,这对传统的心血管风险评估范式提出了挑战。这篇综述综合了目前关于这种关联的观察数据,探讨了可能将 HPV 与动脉粥样硬化联系起来的潜在炎症、免疫和代谢机制,并评估了 HPV 疫苗接种 赋予心血管保护的新证据。大型 队列研究 研究报告,感染 高危型HPV 的女性患心肌梗塞、中风和心血管疾病 死亡率 的风险显着升高,与传统危险因素无关。从机制上讲,HPV癌蛋白E6和E7激活核因子κB(NF-κB)介导的炎症级联反应,通过p53降解诱导内皮功能障碍,并建立以白细胞介素6(IL-6)和肿瘤坏死因子-α(TNF-α)升高为特征的促动脉粥样硬化全身炎症环境。初步回顾性分析进一步表明,HPV 发病率 与新发心脑血管事件 发病率 的减少有关,尽管健康用户偏差和残留混杂因素限制了因果解释。尽管有这些有趣的信号,但大部分证据来自横截面和回顾性设计,并且仍然缺乏因果联系的直接证明。我们讨论了关键的方法论挑战,包括性行为、社会经济地位和合并感染造成的混淆,并概述了前瞻性 队列研究 研究、机制调查和严格的风险分层研究的路线图。澄清 HPV-CVD 关系的性质可以为通过 疫苗接种 项目一级预防动脉粥样硬化疾病开辟新途径。

title: Cervical cytological abnormalities and human papillomavirus status in HPV-vaccinated and unvaccinated women: a cross-sectional study
abstract: To investigate the association between HPV vaccination status and cervical cytological findings, HPV prevalence, and genotype distribution among Iranian women, providing real-world evidence from a population with limited epidemiological data. A cross-sectional study was conducted from March 2023 to February 2024 among 216 women aged 30–65 years attending a tertiary gynecology clinic in Babol, Iran. Participants underwent liquid-based cytology and HPV DNA genotyping. Demographic and clinical data were collected using structured questionnaires and medical records. Comparisons between vaccinated and unvaccinated women were performed using appropriate statistical tests. Overall HPV prevalence was 39.8%. HPV infection was less frequent among vaccinated women (33.3%) than unvaccinated women (42.9%), although the difference was not statistically significant ( P = 0.18). Vaccine-targeted HPV types 16 and 18 were not detected in vaccinated women. The distribution of high-risk HPV genotypes differed significantly between vaccinated and unvaccinated participants ( P < 0.001), with non-vaccine high-risk genotypes predominating among HPV-positive vaccinated women. No significant association was observed between HPV vaccination status and abnormal cervical cytology. HPV vaccination was associated with the absence of vaccine-targeted HPV types 16 and 18 and with differences in HPV genotype distribution. However, non-vaccine high-risk HPV types remained common among vaccinated women, supporting the continued importance of cervical cancer screening alongside HPV vaccination. These findings provide novel epidemiological data on HPV genotype distribution among vaccinated and unvaccinated Iranian women and may help inform future HPV prevention strategies.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现提供了有关已接种疫苗和未接种疫苗的伊朗妇女中 HPV 基因型分布的新流行病学数据,并可能有助于为未来的 HPV 预防策略提供信息。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持 宫颈癌 筛查与 HPV 疫苗接种 一起的持续重要性,因为非 疫苗 高危型HPV 类型在接种疫苗的女性中仍然很常见。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计的限制,无法建立因果关系,而且接种组和未接种组之间的 HPV 感染率缺乏统计学意义,表明证据强度中等。

title: Prevalence of human papillomavirus in the public health system of the central-northern region of Chile.
abstract: OBJECTIVE Previously, we found a high prevalence of high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) in women attending the private health system. Therefore, the objective of this study was to determine the frequency of HR-HPV in a large cohort of women attending the public health system and to compare these findings. METHODS A total of 39,512 cervical samples from women aged 18 to 91 years who attended gynecological check-ups between 2020 and 2024 were analyzed using qPCR and the Papanicolaou technique. RESULTS The overall prevalence of HR-HPV infection between 2020 and 2024 was 13.70% (95% CI: 13.37-14.05%), with annual values of 13.07%, 12.64%, 14.80%, 14.24%, and 14.15% in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024, respectively. In women under 25 years of age, the prevalence of HR-HPV was 34.03% during the evaluated period, compared to 16.35% in women aged 25 to 44 years, 10.47% in those aged 45 to 64 years, and 11.52% in women over 64 years of age. Pap smears showed 89.71% NILM results in HPV-negative women, compared to 74.59% in HPV-positive women. The rates of LSIL and HSIL were 0.14% and 0.07% in HPV-negative women, respectively; however, these values increased to 4.73% and 4.43% in HPV-positive women, respectively. Probable carcinoma was found in only 0.006% of HPV-negative women, but in 0.46% of HPV-positive women. CONCLUSIONS The prevalence of HR-HPV infection in women attending the public health system in the central-northern region appears to be similar to that previously reported in Chile, but lower than that reported in the same region for women attending the private health system.

title: LIG4 Syndrome Presenting with Extensive Cutaneous Viral Warts Caused by Multi-Type HPV Infection
abstract: Background: DNA Ligase 4 (LIG4) catalyzes the final ligation step during V(D)J recombination. Biallelic pathogenic variants in LIG4 cause severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID), a life-threatening immunodeficiency characterized by the lack of mature T and B cells. Case Presentation: An 18-year-old male exhibited widespread verrucous and keratotic cutaneous lesions across the face, neck, and extremities. The proband manifested early-onset short stature, chronic malnutrition, recurrent pulmonary infections with bronchiectasis, chronic diarrhea, and bilateral tenosynovitis. Immunophenotyping revealed persistent panhypogammaglobulinemia, absent B cells, reduced T and natural killer (NK) cells, and nearly undetectable naïve T cells. Both α-HPV and β-HPV were detected in the cutaneous lesions. Compound heterozygous LIG4 variants (hg19, NM206937.2, c.833G > T; p.Arg278Leu inherited from the mother; c.833G > A; p.Arg278 His inherited from the father) were identified. Conclusions: This study reports a proband with LIG4 syndrome presenting with rare phenotypes of multiple viral warts and combined lymphopenia of T, B, and NK cells. This proband harbors compound heterozygous variants at the same codon (c.833G), which not only confirm the clinical diagnosis but also enrich the known phenotypic spectrum of LIG4 syndrome.

Case Presentation: An 18-year-old male exhibited widespread verrucous and keratotic cutaneous lesions across the face, neck, and extremities. The proband manifested early-onset short stature, chronic malnutrition, recurrent pulmonary infections with bronchiectasis, chronic diarrhea, and bilateral tenosynovitis. Immunophenotyping revealed persistent panhypogammaglobulinemia, absent B cells, reduced T and natural killer (NK) cells, and nearly undetectable naïve T cells. Both α-HPV and β-HPV were detected in the cutaneous lesions. Compound heterozygous LIG4 variants (hg19, NM206937.2, c.833G > T; p.Arg278Leu inherited from the mother; c.833G > A; p.Arg278 His inherited from the father) were identified. Conclusions: This study reports a proband with LIG4 syndrome presenting with rare phenotypes of multiple viral warts and combined lymphopenia of T, B, and NK cells. This proband harbors compound heterozygous variants at the same codon (c.833G), which not only confirm the clinical diagnosis but also enrich the known phenotypic spectrum of LIG4 syndrome.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the phenotypic spectrum of LIG4 syndrome, a rare immunodeficiency caused by biallelic LIG4 variants, focusing on its association with extensive cutaneous viral warts and multi-type HPV infection. The rationale stems from the need to expand clinical understanding of genotype-phenotype correlations in LIG4 syndrome beyond classical severe combined immunodeficiency presentations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a single-patient case report describing an 18-year-old male with compound heterozygous LIG4 variants presenting with extensive cutaneous viral warts and combined immunodeficiency. The proband exhibited systemic manifestations including short stature, chronic malnutrition, recurrent pulmonary infections, and chronic diarrhea.
analysis.methods: The study identified compound heterozygous LIG4 variants (c.833G > T; p.Arg278Leu and c.833G > A; p.Arg278His) via genetic sequencing. Immunophenotyping assessed lymphocyte subsets, and HPV typing detected both α-HPV and β-HPV in cutaneous lesions.
analysis.main_results: Immunophenotyping revealed panhypogammaglobulinemia, absent B cells, reduced T and NK cells, and nearly undetectable naïve T cells. Both α-HPV and β-HPV were detected in the cutaneous lesions. Compound heterozygous LIG4 variants at the same codon (c.833G) were confirmed.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as an expansion of the phenotypic spectrum of LIG4 syndrome, highlighting rare presentations with extensive viral warts and combined lymphopenia. The novelty lies in documenting multi-type HPV infection in this immunodeficiency syndrome.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that clinicians should consider LIG4 syndrome in patients with unexplained combined immunodeficiency and extensive cutaneous viral warts, enabling earlier diagnosis and tailored management. The report also underscores the importance of HPV screening in such patients.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to a single case report, restricting generalizability and causal inference. The strength of evidence is low due to the absence of controls, longitudinal data, or mechanistic validation.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old male with LIG4 syndrome caused by compound heterozygous LIG4 variants (c.833G > T and c.833G > A) presenting with extensive cutaneous viral warts and combined immunodeficiency. Immunophenotyping revealed panhypogammaglobulinemia, absent B cells, and reduced T and NK cells. Both α-HPV and β-HPV were detected in the lesions, expanding the known phenotypic spectrum of LIG4 syndrome. The study highlights the need for clinicians to consider LIG4 syndrome in patients with unexplained immunodeficiency and viral warts, enabling earlier diagnosis. However, the evidence is limited to a single case, precluding broader generalizations.

abstract_zh: 背景:DNA 连接酶 4 (LIG4) 催化 V(D)J 重组过程中的最终连接步骤。LIG4 的双等位基因致病性变异会导致严重的联合免疫缺陷 (SCID),这是一种危及生命的免疫缺陷,其特征是缺乏成熟的 T 细胞和 B 细胞。病例介绍:一名 18 岁男性,面部、颈部和四肢出现广泛的疣状和角化性皮肤病变。先证者表现为早发性身材矮小、慢性营养不良、反复肺部感染伴支气管扩张、慢性腹泻和双侧腱鞘炎。免疫表型分析显示持续性全低丙种球蛋白血症、B 细胞缺失、T 细胞和自然杀伤 (NK) 细胞减少以及几乎检测不到的初始 T 细胞。皮损中同时检测到α-HPV和β-HPV。鉴定出复合杂合 LIG4 变体(hg19、NM206937.2、c.833G > T;p.Arg278Leu 遗传自母亲;c.833G > A;p.Arg278 His 遗传自父亲)。结论:本研究报道了一名患有 LIG4 综合征的先证者,其表现出罕见的多发性病毒疣表型以及 T、B 和 NK 细胞联合淋巴细胞减少症。该先证者在同一密码子(c.833G)处存在复合杂合变异,这不仅证实了临床诊断,而且丰富了LIG4综合征的已知表型谱。

title: Coreactant-specific electrochemiluminescence of an anthracene-based zinc framework for detection of HPV-16 DNA.
abstract: The efficient activation of a coreactant is challenging in electrochemiluminescence (ECL) enhancement. Herein, a metal-organic framework nanoemitter was designed with an anthracene derivative as a luminophore ligand and a Zn 2+ node. It demonstrated a 1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane (DABCO)-specific ECL pathway via coordination interaction between the coreactant and the Zn 2+ node, which significantly enhanced emission over conventional coreactants, establishing a sensitive strategy for DNA detection.

title_zh: 用于检测 HPV-16 DNA 的蒽基锌框架的共反应物特异性电化学发光。

title: Clinical Significance of Vulvar Condyloma as a Marker of Concurrent High-Risk Cervical HPV Infection and Abnormal Cervical Cytology
abstract: Background/Objectives: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the principal etiological factor in cervical cancer and its precursor lesions. Although vulvar condyloma is typically associated with low-risk HPV types, high-risk HPV genotypes may coexist. This study evaluated the association between vulvar condyloma, cervical cytological abnormalities, high-risk HPV positivity, and cervical histopathological outcomes. Methods: This retrospective observational study included 407 women evaluated at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Izmir City Hospital, between January 2025 and January 2026. Patients underwent cervical cytology, HPV testing, vulvar examination, and colposcopic biopsy when clinically indicated. Patients were categorized according to the presence or absence of histopathologically confirmed vulvar condyloma. Logistic regression analyses were performed to identify factors associated with vulvar condyloma. Results: Vulvar condyloma was identified in 180 patients (44.2%). Abnormal cervical cytology was recorded in 66/180 patients (36.7%) with vulvar condyloma and 41/227 patients (18.1%) without condyloma (p < 0.001). High-risk HPV positivity was observed in 104/180 (57.8%) and 86/227 (37.9%) patients, respectively (p < 0.001). In multivariate analysis, adjusted ORs were 2.30 for HPV16 positivity (95% CI 1.36–3.89, p = 0.002), 3.29 for HPV18 positivity (95% CI 1.40–7.73, p = 0.006), and 2.01 for abnormal cervical cytology (95% CI 1.24–3.25, p = 0.005). Recorded CIN2+ was 15/180 (8.3%) in the condyloma-positive group and 7/227 (3.1%) in the condyloma-negative group in the overall cohort; in the biopsy-restricted analysis, CIN2+ was 15/82 (18.3%) and 7/41 (17.1%), respectively. Conclusions: Vulvar condyloma was independently associated with abnormal cervical cytology and high-risk HPV infection, particularly HPV16/18 positivity. These robust associations suggest that vulvar condyloma may represent a clinically visible marker of concurrent cervical HPV-related disease. Careful cervical evaluation is warranted in women presenting with vulvar condyloma, whereas CIN2+ findings should be interpreted cautiously until confirmed in larger prospective cohorts with standardized histopathological verification.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 鉴于 HPV 是 宫颈癌 和前驱病变的主要原因,该研究探讨了外阴尖锐湿疣作为并发高危宫颈 HPV 感染和异常宫颈细胞学的潜在指标的临床意义。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性观察研究招募了 2025 年 1 月至 2026 年 1 月期间在伊兹密尔市医院妇产科接受评估的 407 名女性,并根据是否存在经组织病理学证实的外阴尖锐湿疣对她们进行分类。
elements_zh.methods: 当有临床指征时,患者接受宫颈细胞学检查、HPV 检测、外阴检查和阴道镜活检,并使用逻辑回归分析来确定与外阴尖锐湿疣相关的因素。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,外阴尖锐湿疣与宫颈细胞学异常和 高危型HPV 感染(尤其是 HPV16/18)独立相关,表明它可能作为并发宫颈 HPV 相关疾病的临床可见标志物。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持对患有外阴尖锐湿疣的女性进行仔细的宫颈评估,以检测潜在的 高危型HPV 感染和相关的宫颈异常。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的回顾性设计和对单中心 队列研究 的依赖限制了普遍性,在通过标准化组织病理学验证在更大的前瞻性 队列研究 中得到证实之前,应谨慎解释 CIN2+ 关联。

title: KNOWLEDGE, ATTITUDE AND PRACTICE REGARDING HUMAN PAPILLOMA VIRUS (HPV) VACCINE AMONG NURSES AND DOCTORS IN TERTIARY CARE HOSPITALS, LAHORE PAKISTAN: A CROSS-SECTIONAL STUDY
abstract: Background: Cervical cancer is a serious disease that kills many women around the world, especially in developing countries. It is mostly caused by the Human Papillomavirus (HPV). Doctors and nurses are very important because they can teach people about the HPV vaccine and help stop this cancer. Objective: The main objective of this study was to assess knowledge, attitude and practices of doctors and nurses regarding HPV vaccine, employed in tertiary care hospital, Lahore, Pakistan. This study also assesses the association between attitude and practice of participants. Materials and Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional study using an adapted questionnaire, having 3 portions of questions, knowledge questions, attitude questions, and practice questions. A total of 200 healthcare personnel (61% medical officers and 39% of nurses) took part from Fatima Memorial Hospital, Lahore. The data was collected from December 2025 to May 2026, and analyzed using Statistical Package for Social Sciences (SPSS) 26 Mean and Standard. Results: The results showed that most healthcare workers (73% n=146) have a good knowledge level. For example, 78% knew that HPV causes cervical cancer, 69% knew the vaccine is available in Pakistan, and 77% knew the correct age for the vaccine is 9–14 years. Also, 61% correctly chose the Pap smear as the screening test. However, there were some problems: about half of the participants did not know the correct guidelines for catch-up vaccination. Moreover, 72% of participants acquire a good level of attitude and practices. Additionally, results also show a significant association between attitude and practice regarding HPV vaccination. Conclusion: In conclusion, healthcare workers in Lahore have a good understanding of the HPV vaccine, but they still have some knowledge gap about specific guidelines. Medical leaders and policymakers should create clear training programs and workshops to fix these gaps so that doctors and nurses can confidently recommend the vaccine to patients.
journal: Journal of medical & health sciences review.

title_zh: 巴基斯坦拉合尔三级护理医院护士和医生关于人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗 的知识、态度和实践:跨部门研究
source_body_en: Background: Cervical cancer is a serious disease that kills many women around the world, especially in developing countries. It is mostly caused by the Human Papillomavirus (HPV). Doctors and nurses are very important because they can teach people about the HPV vaccine and help stop this cancer. Objective: The main objective of this study was to assess knowledge, attitude and practices of doctors and nurses regarding HPV vaccine, employed in tertiary care hospital, Lahore, Pakistan. This study also assesses the association between attitude and practice of participants. Materials and Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional study using an adapted questionnaire, having 3 portions of questions, knowledge questions, attitude questions, and practice questions. A total of 200 healthcare personnel (61% medical officers and 39% of nurses) took part from Fatima Memorial Hospital, Lahore. The data was collected from December 2025 to May 2026, and analyzed using Statistical Package for Social Sciences (SPSS) 26 Mean and Standard. Results: The results showed that most healthcare workers (73% n=146) have a good knowledge level. For example, 78% knew that HPV causes cervical cancer, 69% knew the vaccine is available in Pakistan, and 77% knew the correct age for the vaccine is 9–14 years. Also, 61% correctly chose the Pap smear as the screening test. However, there were some problems: about half of the participants did not know the correct guidelines for catch-up vaccination. Moreover, 72% of participants acquire a good level of attitude and practices. Additionally, results also show a significant association between attitude and practice regarding HPV vaccination. Conclusion: In conclusion, healthcare workers in Lahore have a good understanding of the HPV vaccine, but they still have some knowledge gap about specific guidelines. Medical leaders and policymakers should create clear training programs and workshops to fix these gaps so that doctors and nurses can confidently recommend the vaccine to patients.

title: Immunogenicity, efficacy, and safety of different dose schedules of human papillomavirus vaccines: a Bayesian network meta–analysis of randomized controlled trials
abstract: Background To enhance global vaccine coverage and reduce costs, Human papillomavirus (HPV) immunization schedules are shifting from the standard three–dose (3D) regimen toward reduced–dose (1D or 2D) schedules. We aimed to evaluate the comparative immunogenicity, efficacy, and safety of diverse dose schedules and vaccine types using a Bayesian network meta–analysis. Methods Two reviewers independently searched PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), CNKI, and Wanfang Data from inception to February 15, 2026, for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating different dose schedules of HPV vaccines in females aged 9–26 years. Primary outcomes were HPV–16/18 Seroconversion rates (SCR) and 6–month Persistent infection (PI). A Bayesian random–effects model was constructed using the multinma package in R, and treatments were ranked using the Surface Under the Cumulative Ranking (SUCRA) values. Results For immunogenicity, the 9v–3D regimen demonstrated the highest SCR compared with placebo (OR 62.45, 95% CrI 15.20–158.30; SUCRA 0.96). However, these large effect estimates are largely driven by near–zero events in placebo arms. Regarding protective efficacy against PI, while 3–dose regimens ranked highest (9v–3D SUCRA 0.95; 2v–3D SUCRA 0.89), single–dose schedules (1D) maintained clinically significant protection (e.g., 2v–1D vs. placebo: OR 0.32, 95% CrI 0.07–0.96; SUCRA 0.61). Safety rankings identified 1D schedules as having the lowest risk of injection–site pain (SUCRA: 2v–1D 88.0%, 9v–1D 82.0%). Subgroup analysis suggested comparable efficacy of 2–dose regimens in adolescents aged 9–14 years compared to the standard 3D regimen (P–interaction = 0.04). Conclusions Although reduced–dose schedules induce lower antibody titers than the standard 3–dose regimen, they provide robust protective efficacy against persistent HPV infection with a superior safety profile. Our findings support the widespread adoption of 2–dose schedules in adolescents and suggest that a single–dose strategy is a viable alternative in resource–constrained settings to accelerate the elimination of cervical cancer. However, given the surrogate nature of the study endpoints and the limitations of network meta-analysis for establishing non-inferiority, cautious interpretation of these results is warranted, and further long-term clinical endpoint data are needed.

title_original: Immunogenicity, efficacy, and safety of different dose schedules of human papillomavirus vaccines: a Bayesian network meta–analysis of randomized controlled trials

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the public-health need to optimize human papillomavirus (HPV) immunization schedules to increase global coverage and reduce costs by shifting from the standard three-dose regimen to reduced-dose schedules. It asked whether one-dose or two-dose schedules maintain adequate immunogenicity, efficacy, and safety compared with the three-dose schedule.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A Bayesian network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials was conducted, synthesizing data from PubMed, Embase, CENTRAL, CNKI, and Wanfang Data up to February 15, 2026. Included trials evaluated different dose schedules of HPV vaccines in females aged 9–26 years.
analysis.methods: Two reviewers independently searched multiple databases and constructed a Bayesian random-effects model using the multinma package in R. Treatments were ranked with Surface Under the Cumulative Ranking (SUCRA) values, and primary outcomes were HPV-16/18 seroconversion rates and 6-month persistent infection.
analysis.main_results: For immunogenicity, the 9-valent three-dose regimen showed the highest seroconversion rate versus placebo (OR 62.45, 95% CrI 15.20–158.30; SUCRA 0.96), though estimates were driven by near-zero events in placebo arms. Single-dose schedules maintained clinically significant protection against persistent infection (e.g., 2-valent one-dose vs. placebo: OR 0.32, 95% CrI 0.07–0.96; SUCRA 0.61). Safety rankings indicated one-dose schedules had the lowest risk of injection-site pain.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that reduced-dose schedules induce lower antibody titers than the standard three-dose regimen but provide robust protective efficacy against persistent HPV infection with a superior safety profile. They highlighted that two-dose schedules in adolescents aged 9–14 years may be comparable to the three-dose regimen.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support adopting two-dose schedules in adolescents and suggest that a single-dose strategy could be a viable alternative in resource-constrained settings to accelerate cervical cancer elimination. The results imply that policy changes toward reduced-dose regimens may enhance vaccination coverage without compromising protection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited by the surrogate nature of endpoints and the constraints of network meta-analysis for establishing non-inferiority, warranting cautious interpretation and the need for long-term clinical endpoint data. Confidence in the comparative rankings is moderate due to reliance on indirect evidence and potential bias from near-zero placebo events.

analysis.summary_en: This Bayesian network meta-analysis evaluated immunogenicity, efficacy, and safety of reduced-dose human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine schedules compared with the standard three-dose regimen. Using randomized controlled trial data from females aged 9–26 years, the study found that while three-dose schedules ranked highest for immunogenicity, single-dose schedules maintained clinically significant protection against persistent HPV infection with a superior safety profile. Two-dose schedules in adolescents aged 9–14 years appeared comparable to the three-dose regimen. The authors conclude that reduced-dose schedules can support global HPV immunization goals, particularly in resource-limited settings, though long-term clinical endpoint data are needed to confirm non-inferiority.

title_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗 不同剂量方案的免疫原性、功效和安全性:随机对照试验的贝叶斯网络荟萃分析
source_body_en: Background To enhance global vaccine coverage and reduce costs, Human papillomavirus (HPV) immunization schedules are shifting from the standard three–dose (3D) regimen toward reduced–dose (1D or 2D) schedules. We aimed to evaluate the comparative immunogenicity, efficacy, and safety of diverse dose schedules and vaccine types using a Bayesian network meta–analysis. Methods Two reviewers independently searched PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), CNKI, and Wanfang Data from inception to February 15, 2026, for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating different dose schedules of HPV vaccines in females aged 9–26 years. Primary outcomes were HPV–16/18 Seroconversion rates (SCR) and 6–month Persistent infection (PI). A Bayesian random–effects model was constructed using the multinma package in R, and treatments were ranked using the Surface Under the Cumulative Ranking (SUCRA) values. Results For immunogenicity, the 9v–3D regimen demonstrated the highest SCR compared with placebo (OR 62.45, 95% CrI 15.20–158.30; SUCRA 0.96). However, these large effect estimates are largely driven by near–zero events in placebo arms. Regarding protective efficacy against PI, while 3–dose regimens ranked highest (9v–3D SUCRA 0.95; 2v–3D SUCRA 0.89), single–dose schedules (1D) maintained clinically significant protection (e.g., 2v–1D vs. placebo: OR 0.32, 95% CrI 0.07–0.96; SUCRA 0.61). Safety rankings identified 1D schedules as having the lowest risk of injection–site pain (SUCRA: 2v–1D 88.0%, 9v–1D 82.0%). Subgroup analysis suggested comparable efficacy of 2–dose regimens in adolescents aged 9–14 years compared to the standard 3D regimen (P–interaction = 0.04). Conclusions Although reduced–dose schedules induce lower antibody titers than the standard 3–dose regimen, they provide robust protective efficacy against persistent HPV infection with a superior safety profile. Our findings support the widespread adoption of 2–dose schedules in adolescents and suggest that a single–dose strategy is a viable alternative in resource–constrained settings to accelerate the elimination of cervical cancer. However, given the surrogate nature of the study endpoints and the limitations of network meta-analysis for establishing non-inferiority, cautious interpretation of these results is warranted, and further long-term clinical endpoint data are needed.

title: High-risk human papillomavirus and risk of colorectal cancer: a preliminary study in South of Iran
abstract: The incidence rate of colorectal cancer is on the rise in Iran. Although the precise etiology of colorectal cancer remains unknown, high-risk human papillomaviruses (HPVs) are suggested as potential contributors to the pathogenesis of colorectal cancer. Information on the prevalence of HPV infection among patients with colorectal cancer can affect targeted prevention and management strategies by improving region-specific screening strategies and HPV vaccination. Therefore, this study was designed to detect high-risk HPVs in colorectal cancer tissue specimens in the South of Iran. Colorectal biopsy samples from 147 patients with colorectal cancer and 144 non-cancerous patients with colorectal inflammation and polyps were tested for the detection of HPVs by nested PCR assay. High-risk HPVs were detected in 2 samples of 128 colorectal cancer samples (1.56%, 95% CI: 0.48%-5.49%), while the non-cancerous colorectal samples were HPV negative. HPV-positive patients were identified in the age group ≥ 80 years (8.33%) and the age group 70–79 years (5.26%), while the age groups < 70 years did not show HPV positivity. The frequency of HPV infection was approximately equal in both genders (1.54% in males and 1.59% in females). HPV DNA was detected in 9.09% of patients resident in Ahram and 4.35% of patients resident in Khormoj, whereas the residents of Bushehr, Borazjan, Dayer, Genaveh, and Kangan were negative for HPV infection. The prevalence of HPV infection among patients with colorectal cancer was not statistically associated with age, gender, and place of residency. Although the patients with rectal adenocarcinoma (3.33%) showed a higher rate of HPV positivity compared to the patients with colon adenocarcinoma (1.02%), the frequency of HPV infection was not significantly associated with the anatomical location of colorectal cancer. This study, despite detecting HPVs in 1.56% of colorectal cancer biopsy specimens, cannot determine the possible association between HPV infection and colorectal carcinogenesis in the South of Iran. The causal relationship between HPV infection and colorectal cancer appears to be influenced by environmental and individual risk factors, the genetic backgrounds, as well as the regional epidemiology of HPV infection.

title_zh: 高风险 人乳头瘤病毒 与结直肠癌风险:伊朗南部的初步研究
source_body_en: The incidence rate of colorectal cancer is on the rise in Iran. Although the precise etiology of colorectal cancer remains unknown, high-risk human papillomaviruses (HPVs) are suggested as potential contributors to the pathogenesis of colorectal cancer. Information on the prevalence of HPV infection among patients with colorectal cancer can affect targeted prevention and management strategies by improving region-specific screening strategies and HPV vaccination. Therefore, this study was designed to detect high-risk HPVs in colorectal cancer tissue specimens in the South of Iran. Colorectal biopsy samples from 147 patients with colorectal cancer and 144 non-cancerous patients with colorectal inflammation and polyps were tested for the detection of HPVs by nested PCR assay. High-risk HPVs were detected in 2 samples of 128 colorectal cancer samples (1.56%, 95% CI: 0.48%-5.49%), while the non-cancerous colorectal samples were HPV negative. HPV-positive patients were identified in the age group ≥ 80 years (8.33%) and the age group 70–79 years (5.26%), while the age groups < 70 years did not show HPV positivity. The frequency of HPV infection was approximately equal in both genders (1.54% in males and 1.59% in females). HPV DNA was detected in 9.09% of patients resident in Ahram and 4.35% of patients resident in Khormoj, whereas the residents of Bushehr, Borazjan, Dayer, Genaveh, and Kangan were negative for HPV infection. The prevalence of HPV infection among patients with colorectal cancer was not statistically associated with age, gender, and place of residency. Although the patients with rectal adenocarcinoma (3.33%) showed a higher rate of HPV positivity compared to the patients with colon adenocarcinoma (1.02%), the frequency of HPV infection was not significantly associated with the anatomical location of colorectal cancer. This study, despite detecting HPVs in 1.56% of colorectal cancer biopsy specimens, cannot determine the possible association between HPV infection and colorectal carcinogenesis in the South of Iran. The causal relationship between HPV infection and colorectal cancer appears to be influenced by environmental and individual risk factors, the genetic backgrounds, as well as the regional epidemiology of HPV infection.

title: The Vaginal Microbiota of Adult Malagasy Women of Reproductive Age in the Marovoay District: First Characterization and Exploration of Associations With Human Papillomavirus and Schistosoma haematobium Infections.
abstract: BACKGROUND: The vaginal microbiome plays an important role for women's health. Changes in its composition have been associated with several sexually transmitted infections, including human papillomavirus (HPV) or parasitic infections such as Schistosoma haematobium. In Madagascar, gynecological conditions such as chronic manifestations of S. haematobium infections (female genital schistosomiasis), HPV infections, and cervical cancer are highly prevalent; however, data on the interplay between these conditions and the vaginal microbiota (VM) are still scarce. In addition, the majority of data originates from the Global North, generating a biased understanding of "healthy" VM across different geographic and social contexts. The objective of our study was to characterize for the first time the VM of adult women of reproductive age in Madagascar and to describe the variability of the vaginal environment in the presence of 3 conditions affecting the urogenital tract. METHODS AND RESULTS: We characterized the VM of 443 participants, identifying the 5 community state types (CSTs I-V), with CST IV (57.1%, diverse) and CST III (34.1%, Lactobacillus iners dominated) as the most prevalent. CSTs were associated with previous antibiotics usage, while variability in the alpha and beta diversity was associated with dietary behavior and previous antibiotic usage. Differential abundance analysis showed variations among specific taxa in HPV-positive and female genital schistosomiasis-positive participants. CONCLUSIONS: With this first study of the VM in Madagascar we contribute to a broader understanding of vaginal health, as well as narrowing the gap of VM research in sub-Saharan Africa by enriching microbiota databases.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the scarcity of data on the vaginal microbiota (VM) in Madagascar and its interplay with prevalent urogenital infections, including human papillomavirus (HPV). The authors highlighted a geographic and social bias in existing VM research, which is largely derived from the Global North.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a cross-sectional characterization study of 443 adult women of reproductive age in the Marovoay District of Madagascar. The study aimed to describe VM variability in the presence of three urogenital tract conditions, including HPV infection.
analysis.methods: The VM was characterized by identifying community state types (CSTs) I–V, with CST IV (diverse) and CST III (Lactobacillus iners dominated) being the most prevalent. Alpha and beta diversity were assessed, and differential abundance analysis was performed to compare taxa among participants with HPV infection, female genital schistosomiasis, and controls.
analysis.main_results: CST IV was observed in 57.1% of participants and CST III in 34.1%. CSTs were associated with previous antibiotic usage, while alpha and beta diversity variability was linked to dietary behavior and prior antibiotic use. Differential abundance analysis revealed variations in specific taxa among HPV-positive participants compared to others.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as contributing to a broader understanding of vaginal health in Madagascar and addressing the research gap in sub-Saharan Africa by enriching microbiota databases. They emphasized the novelty of being the first study to characterize the VM in this population.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform future surveillance and research priorities in Madagascar by highlighting associations between VM composition, HPV infection, and other urogenital conditions. This could guide targeted interventions for women's reproductive health in the region.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which precludes causal inference. The evidence strength is moderate due to potential confounding from dietary and antibiotic use factors and the lack of longitudinal follow-up.

analysis.summary_en: This study characterized the vaginal microbiota (VM) of 443 Malagasy women of reproductive age in the Marovoay District, identifying CST IV (57.1%) and CST III (34.1%) as dominant community state types. CSTs were associated with prior antibiotic use, while VM diversity correlated with dietary behavior and antibiotic exposure. Differential abundance analysis showed specific taxa variations in HPV-positive participants. The authors interpret these findings as the first VM characterization in Madagascar, addressing a geographic research gap and contributing to broader vaginal health understanding. The cross-sectional design limits causal inference, and evidence strength is moderate due to confounding factors.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了马达加斯加阴道微生物群 (VM) 数据的缺乏及其与流行的泌尿生殖道感染(包括 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV))的相互作用的问题。作者强调了现有 VM 研究中的地理和社会偏见,这些偏见主要来自北半球。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是对马达加斯加马洛沃伊区 443 名育龄成年女性的横断面特征研究。该研究旨在描述三种泌尿生殖道疾病(包括 HPV 感染)下 VM 的变异性。
elements_zh.methods: VM 的特点是识别群落状态类型 (CST) I-V,其中 CST IV(多样化)和 CST III(惰性乳杆菌为主)最为普遍。评估了 α 和 β 多样性,并进行了差异丰度分析,以比较 HPV 感染参与者、女性生殖器血吸虫病和对照者之间的分类群。
elements_zh.main_results: 参与者中观察到57.1%的受试者为CST IV型,34.1%的受试者为CST III型。CST类型与既往抗生素使用史相关,而α多样性和β多样性的变异性则与饮食行为及既往抗生素使用史相关联。差异丰度分析显示,与其他受试者相比,HPV阳性受试者中特定分类单元存在差异。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为有助于更广泛地了解马达加斯加的阴道健康,并通过丰富微生物群数据库来解决撒哈拉以南非洲地区的研究空白。他们强调了作为第一个描述该人群 VM 特征的研究的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究结果可能通过强调 VM 组成、HPV 感染和其他泌尿生殖系统疾病之间的关联,为未来的 监测 和马达加斯加的研究重点提供信息。这可以指导该地区妇女生殖健康的有针对性的干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横截面设计的限制,无法进行因果推断。由于饮食和抗生素使用因素的潜在混淆以及缺乏纵向随访,证据强度中等。

title_zh: 马罗瓦伊区马达加斯加成年育龄妇女的阴道微生物群:与 人乳头瘤病毒 和埃及血吸虫感染关联的首次表征和探索。

abstract_zh: 背景:阴道微生物群对女性健康起着重要作用。其成分的变化与多种性传播感染有关,包括 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 或埃及血吸虫等寄生虫感染。在马达加斯加,妇科疾病例如埃及沙门氏菌感染(女性生殖器血吸虫病)、HPV 感染和 宫颈癌 的慢性表现非常普遍;然而,有关这些条件与阴道微生物群 (VM) 之间相互作用的数据仍然很少。此外,大多数数据来自北半球,导致不同地理和社会背景下对“健康”虚拟机的理解存在偏见。我们研究的目的是首次描述马达加斯加育龄成年女性的 VM 特征,并描述在 3 种影响泌尿生殖道的情况下阴道环境的变化。方法和结果:我们对 443 名参与者的 VM 进行了表征,确定了 5 种社区状态类型 (CST I-V),其中 CST IV(57.1%,多样化)和 CST III(34.1%,乳酸杆菌占主导)最为普遍。CST 与之前的抗生素使用相关,而 α 和 β 多样性的变异性与饮食行为和之前的抗生素使用相关。差异丰度分析显示 HPV 阳性和女性生殖器血吸虫病阳性参与者的特定分类群之间存在差异。结论:通过在马达加斯加对 VM 进行的首次研究,我们有助于更广泛地了解阴道健康,并通过丰富微生物群数据库来缩小撒哈拉以南非洲 VM 研究的差距。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了马达加斯加阴道微生物群 (VM) 数据的缺乏及其与流行的泌尿生殖道感染(包括 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV))的相互作用的问题。作者强调了现有 VM 研究中的地理和社会偏见,这些偏见主要来自北半球。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是对马达加斯加马洛沃伊区 443 名育龄成年女性的横断面特征研究。该研究旨在描述三种泌尿生殖道疾病(包括 HPV 感染)下 VM 的变异性。
analysis_zh.methods: VM 的特点是识别群落状态类型 (CST) I-V,其中 CST IV(多样化)和 CST III(惰性乳杆菌为主)最为普遍。评估了 α 和 β 多样性,并进行了差异丰度分析,以比较 HPV 感染参与者、女性生殖器血吸虫病和对照者之间的分类群。
analysis_zh.main_results: 参与者中观察到57.1%的受试者为CST IV型,34.1%的受试者为CST III型。CST类型与既往抗生素使用史相关,而α多样性和β多样性的变异性则与饮食行为及既往抗生素使用史相关联。差异丰度分析显示,与其他受试者相比,HPV阳性受试者中特定分类单元存在差异。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为有助于更广泛地了解马达加斯加的阴道健康,并通过丰富微生物群数据库来解决撒哈拉以南非洲地区的研究空白。他们强调了作为第一个描述该人群 VM 特征的研究的新颖性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究结果可能通过强调 VM 组成、HPV 感染和其他泌尿生殖系统疾病之间的关联,为未来的 监测 和马达加斯加的研究重点提供信息。这可以指导该地区妇女生殖健康的有针对性的干预措施。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横截面设计的限制,无法进行因果推断。由于饮食和抗生素使用因素的潜在混淆以及缺乏纵向随访,证据强度中等。

title: Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Proportion and Genotype Distribution among Reproductive age Women of a Hilly District of Nepal
abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is a leading cause of cervical cancer, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) with limited access to preventive services. This study was aimed to assess high-risk HPV prevalence and genotype distribution among reproductive-age women in Palpa district of Nepal and compare them with demographic and clinical data.Methods: A small, community based, non-probability convenience sampling approach was used for data collection in which cervical swabs were collected from 2,331 women aged 20 to 45 years from Rampur and Rambha municipalities of Palpa district, who attended the health camps organized from 7th February 2025 to 7th October 2025, after obtaining ethical approval from the Nepal Health Research Council (NHRC), Nepal. Out of 2,331 cervical swab samples, 2,024 swab samples were only processed due to pre-analytical errors for HPV DNA detection using the Nucleic Acid Extraction Kit and genotypes identified through RT-PCR using the Human Papillomavirus Nucleic Acid Amplification Test Kit. Results: HPV positivity among participants were found to be 3.5%. Other HPV genotype (non 16/18) were most frequently observed among HPV positive participant 35(49.3%), followed by HPV 16 genotype (29.5%) and HPV 18 (16.9%). The women between 35–40 years age group had the highest proportion of HPV positive cases (36 cases). The logistic regression between HPV infection and the presence of cervical lesions yielded an odds ratio of 2.999, indicating that women with cervical lesions were nearly three times more likely to have HPV infection than those without lesions. Conclusions: The study showed low HPV positive proportion rate, with non-16/18 genotypes predominating. Women aged 35–40 years had the highest HPV positivity, and HPV infection was found to be more common among women with cervical lesions.Keywords: Cervical swabs; genotypes; High risk- HPV; real time PCR.

title_zh: 尼泊尔丘陵地区育龄妇女人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV)比例和基因型分布
source_body_en: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is a leading cause of cervical cancer, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) with limited access to preventive services. This study was aimed to assess high-risk HPV prevalence and genotype distribution among reproductive-age women in Palpa district of Nepal and compare them with demographic and clinical data.Methods: A small, community based, non-probability convenience sampling approach was used for data collection in which cervical swabs were collected from 2,331 women aged 20 to 45 years from Rampur and Rambha municipalities of Palpa district, who attended the health camps organized from 7th February 2025 to 7th October 2025, after obtaining ethical approval from the Nepal Health Research Council (NHRC), Nepal. Out of 2,331 cervical swab samples, 2,024 swab samples were only processed due to pre-analytical errors for HPV DNA detection using the Nucleic Acid Extraction Kit and genotypes identified through RT-PCR using the Human Papillomavirus Nucleic Acid Amplification Test Kit. Results: HPV positivity among participants were found to be 3.5%. Other HPV genotype (non 16/18) were most frequently observed among HPV positive participant 35(49.3%), followed by HPV 16 genotype (29.5%) and HPV 18 (16.9%). The women between 35–40 years age group had the highest proportion of HPV positive cases (36 cases). The logistic regression between HPV infection and the presence of cervical lesions yielded an odds ratio of 2.999, indicating that women with cervical lesions were nearly three times more likely to have HPV infection than those without lesions. Conclusions: The study showed low HPV positive proportion rate, with non-16/18 genotypes predominating. Women aged 35–40 years had the highest HPV positivity, and HPV infection was found to be more common among women with cervical lesions.Keywords: Cervical swabs; genotypes; High risk- HPV; real time PCR.

title: Clinical Significance of High-Risk HPV Positivity with Negative Cytology: Can Further Evaluation Be Safely Delayed?
abstract: Background and Objectives: Primary HPV screening has high sensitivity in detecting premalignant and malignant cervical lesions. However, due to its relatively low specificity, this screening approach requires triage tests. Owing to its high specificity, cytology is most commonly employed in the triage of HPV-positive results. Nevertheless, the question remains as to how reliable cytology is in triaging these cases, given its relatively low sensitivity. This study evaluates the clinical significance of high-risk HPV (hrHPV) positivity in women with negative or low-grade cytological findings and assesses whether further evaluation can be safely deferred using HPV genotyping, colposcopy, and p16/Ki-67 biomarkers. Materials and Methods: A prospective hospital-based observational study was conducted on 125 women with a positive hrHPV cervical test. All participants underwent conventional cytology, extended HPV genotyping, colposcopy, and histopathological evaluation via biopsy or loop excision. Immunohistochemical analysis of p16 and Ki-67 expressions was performed on histopathological tissue samples. Particular attention was focused on women with negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy (NILM) and low-grade cytological findings. Associations between cytology, HPV genotype distribution, colposcopic findings, histopathology, smoking status, and biomarker expression were analyzed. Results: Among HPV-positive patients with NILM cytology, CIN2+ lesions were histopathologically confirmed in 28.0% of cases. More than half (51.4%) of all CIN2+ lesions detected in HPV-positive women were identified in patients with low-grade or negative cytology. HPV16/18 positivity was highly prevalent among women with CIN2+ lesions and low-grade cytological findings (78.4%). Unsatisfactory colposcopy with a non-visible squamocolumnar junction (transformation zone type 3, TZ3) was identified in more than half of these patients. Immunohistochemical markers p16 and Ki-67 demonstrated high sensitivity (95.5%) and negative predictive value (93.3%) for detecting CIN2+ lesions in hrHPV-positive women with low-grade cytology (NILM, ASC-US, and LSIL). Smoking status was significantly associated with CIN2+ lesions in this patient group (p < 0.001). Conclusions: Deferring further evaluation of hrHPV-positive women solely based on negative cytology may be unsafe, particularly in older women, smokers, and those positive for HPV16/18. The strong association between p16/Ki-67 positivity and CIN2+ lesions suggests that dual-stain testing directly from cytological samples could significantly improve triage strategies and reduce the need for invasive procedures.

However, due to its relatively low specificity, this screening approach requires triage tests. Owing to its high specificity, cytology is most commonly employed in the triage of HPV-positive results. Nevertheless, the question remains as to how reliable cytology is in triaging these cases, given its relatively low sensitivity. This study evaluates the clinical significance of high-risk HPV (hrHPV) positivity in women with negative or low-grade cytological findings and assesses whether further evaluation can be safely deferred using HPV genotyping, colposcopy, and p16/Ki-67 biomarkers. Materials and Methods: A prospective hospital-based observational study was conducted on 125 women with a positive hrHPV cervical test. All participants underwent conventional cytology, extended HPV genotyping, colposcopy, and histopathological evaluation via biopsy or loop excision. Immunohistochemical analysis of p16 and Ki-67 expressions was performed on histopathological tissue samples. Particular attention was focused on women with negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy (NILM) and low-grade cytological findings. Associations between cytology, HPV genotype distribution, colposcopic findings, histopathology, smoking status, and biomarker expression were analyzed. Results: Among HPV-positive patients with NILM cytology, CIN2+ lesions were histopathologically confirmed in 28.0% of cases. More than half (51.4%) of all CIN2+ lesions detected in HPV-positive women were identified in patients with low-grade or negative cytology. HPV16/18 positivity was highly prevalent among women with CIN2+ lesions and low-grade cytological findings (78.4%). Unsatisfactory colposcopy with a non-visible squamocolumnar junction (transformation zone type 3, TZ3) was identified in more than half of these patients. Immunohistochemical markers p16 and Ki-67 demonstrated high sensitivity (95.5%) and negative predictive value (93.3%) for detecting CIN2+ lesions in hrHPV-positive women with low-grade cytology (NILM, ASC-US, and LSIL). Smoking status was significantly associated with CIN2+ lesions in this patient group (p < 0.001). Conclusions: Deferring further evaluation of hrHPV-positive women solely based on negative cytology may be unsafe, particularly in older women, smokers, and those positive for HPV16/18. The strong association between p16/Ki-67 positivity and CIN2+ lesions suggests that dual-stain testing directly from cytological samples could significantly improve triage strategies and reduce the need for invasive procedures.
abstract_zh: 背景和目的:初次 HPV 筛查对于检测宫颈癌前病变和恶性宫颈病变具有较高的敏感性。然而,由于其特异性相对较低,这种筛查方法需要分类测试。由于其高度特异性,细胞学最常用于 HPV 阳性结果的分类。尽管如此,鉴于细胞学的敏感性相对较低,问题仍然是细胞学在分类这些病例时的可靠性如何。本研究评估了细胞学结果阴性或低级别女性中 高危型HPV (hrHPV) 阳性的临床意义,并评估是否可以使用 HPV 基因分型、阴道镜检查和 p16/Ki-67 生物标志物安全地推迟进一步评估。材料和方法:对 125 名 hrHPV 宫颈检测呈阳性的女性进行了一项前瞻性医院观察研究。所有参与者均接受了常规细胞学检查、扩展 HPV 基因分型、阴道镜检查以及通​​过活检或环切除进行的组织病理学评估。对组织病理学组织样本进行 p16 和 Ki-67 表达的免疫组织化学分析。特别关注上皮内病变或恶性肿瘤(NILM)阴性和低级别细胞学检查结果的女性。分析了细胞学、HPV 基因型分布、阴道镜检查结果、组织病理学、吸烟状况和生物标志物表达之间的关联。结果:在进行 NILM 细胞学检查的 HPV 阳性患者中,28.0% 的病例经组织病理学证实为 CIN2+ 病变。在 HPV 阳性女性中检测到的所有 CIN2+ 病变中,超过一半 (51.4%) 是在细胞学低级别或阴性的患者中发现的。HPV16/18 阳性在患有 CIN2+ 病变和低级别细胞学检查结果的女性中非常普遍 (78.4%)。在超过一半的患者中,阴道镜检查结果不满意,鳞柱状交界处不可见(3 型转化区,TZ3)。免疫组织化学标记物 p16 和 Ki-67 在检测具有低级别细胞学检查(NILM、ASC-US 和 LSIL)的 hrHPV 阳性女性中的 CIN2+ 病变时表现出高灵敏度 (95.5%) 和阴性预测值 (93.3%)。在该患者组中,吸烟状况与 CIN2+ 病变显着相关 (p < 0.001)。结论:仅根据阴性细胞学结果推迟对 hrHPV 阳性女性进行进一步评估可能是不安全的,特别是对于老年女性、吸烟者和 HPV16/18 阳性女性。p16/Ki-67 阳性与 CIN2+ 病变之间的密切相关性表明,直接对细胞学样本进行双染色检测可以显着改善分诊策略并减少侵入性操作的需要。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 初级 HPV 筛查可检测宫颈癌前病变和恶性宫颈病变,敏感性高但特异性低,需要进行细胞学等分类测试。该研究探讨了细胞学对细胞学结果阴性或低级别 hrHPV 阳性女性进行分类的可靠性,以及是否可以安全地推迟进一步评估。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 125 名 hrHPV 宫颈检测呈阳性的女性进行了一项前瞻性医院观察研究。参与者接受了常规细胞学检查、扩展 HPV 基因分型、阴道镜检查和组织病理学评估,并对 p16 和 Ki-67 表达进行免疫组织化学分析。
analysis_zh.methods: 进行了常规细胞学检查、扩展 HPV 基因分型、阴道镜检查以及通​​过活检或环切除进行的组织病理学评估。对组织病理学组织样本进行 p16 和 Ki-67 表达的免疫组织化学分析,并分析细胞学、HPV 基因型分布、阴道镜检查结果、组织病理学、吸烟状况和生物标志物表达之间的关联。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在进行 NILM 细胞学检查的 HPV 阳性患者中,28.0% 的病例确诊为 CIN2+ 病变。在 HPV 阳性女性中,超过一半 (51.4%) 的 CIN2+ 病变是在细胞学级别低或阴性的患者中发现的。HPV16/18 阳性在 CIN2+ 病变和低级别细胞学检查的女性中普遍存在 (78.4%)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究解释说,仅根据阴性细胞学结果推迟对 hrHPV 阳性女性进行进一步评估可能是不安全的,特别是对于老年女性、吸烟者和 HPV16/18 阳性女性。p16/Ki-67 阳性与 CIN2+ 病变之间的密切相关性表明双染色测试可以改善分诊策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果告诫不要延迟对细胞学阴性的 hrHPV 阳性女性进行评估,尤其是在高危亚组中,并支持使用 p16/Ki-67 双染色检测来完善分诊并减少侵入性操作。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其单中心、基于医院的设计和小样本量而受到限制,这可能会影响普遍性。由于观察性质和潜在的选择偏差,证据强度中等。

title: A retrospective study on the prevalence of human papillomavirus types in women in Isfahan, central Iran between 2015 and 2024
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) causes the most prevalent sexually transmitted infection and is the principal cause of cervical cancer. Despite several regional reports from Iran, comprehensive and updated data on HPV prevalence and genotype distribution among women in Isfahan, central Iran, remain limited. The present study aimed to determine the prevalence of HPV infection and HPV types in the recordings of women referred for genital HPV screening to a Medical Laboratory in Isfahan, central Iran. In this retrospective study, HPV PCR and genotyping results of 4,973 women and their available demographic data screened between 2015 and 2024 at a referral laboratory in Isfahan were collected, analyzed and reported. Of 4,973 women screened, 819 (16.5%) tested HPV-positive. HPV6 was the most common genotype (9.2%). Among HPV-positive women, high-risk types were slightly more frequent than low-risk types (55.2% vs. 44.8%), with HPV16 (14.4%) the most prevalent high-risk genotype, followed by HPV53 (13.2%) and HPV18 (6.2%). HPV positivity was highest in women under 20 years of age (27.3%; P = 0.002). Based on the results of the present study, the rate of HPV infection in Isfahan was high, yet comparable to that reported in several other regions in Iran. More than half of HPV-positive women were infected with high-risk types in Isfahan area. Among the tested population, the highest positivity was observed in women under 20 years old.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the most common sexually transmitted infection and a principal cause of cervical cancer, yet comprehensive and updated data on HPV prevalence and genotype distribution in Isfahan, central Iran, remain limited despite regional reports.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective study analyzed HPV PCR and genotyping results from 4,973 women screened between 2015 and 2024 at a referral laboratory in Isfahan, central Iran.
analysis.methods: The study collected and analyzed HPV PCR and genotyping results alongside available demographic data from women referred for genital HPV screening.
analysis.main_results: Of 4,973 women screened, 819 (16.5%) tested HPV-positive, with HPV6 being the most common genotype (9.2%). Among HPV-positive women, high-risk types were slightly more frequent than low-risk types (55.2% vs. 44.8%), with HPV16 (14.4%) the most prevalent high-risk genotype, followed by HPV53 (13.2%) and HPV18 (6.2%). HPV positivity was highest in women under 20 years of age (27.3%; P = 0.002).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the high HPV infection rate in Isfahan as comparable to other regions in Iran and noted that more than half of HPV-positive women were infected with high-risk types, highlighting the burden of oncogenic HPV in the population.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest a substantial burden of HPV infection and high-risk genotypes in Isfahan, which may inform local vaccination strategies and cervical cancer screening programs.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s retrospective design and reliance on a single referral laboratory limit generalizability, and the absence of clinical outcomes or longitudinal follow-up reduces the strength of evidence for causal inference.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed HPV PCR and genotyping results from 4,973 women screened in Isfahan, Iran, between 2015 and 2024. Overall, 16.5% tested HPV-positive, with HPV6 as the most common genotype (9.2%). Among HPV-positive women, high-risk types predominated (55.2%), led by HPV16 (14.4%), HPV53 (13.2%), and HPV18 (6.2%). Infection was most frequent in women under 20 years (27.3%). The authors conclude that HPV prevalence in Isfahan is high and comparable to other Iranian regions, with a notable proportion of high-risk infections. These findings may guide local vaccination and screening policies, though the single-center, retrospective design and lack of outcome data limit generalizability and causal inference.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 是最常见的性传播感染,也是 宫颈癌 的主要原因,尽管有区域报告,但伊朗中部伊斯法罕的 HPV 患病率 和基因型分布的全面和最新数据仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性研究分析了 2015 年至 2024 年间在伊朗中部伊斯法罕转诊实验室筛查的 4,973 名女性的 HPV PCR 和基因分型结果。
